entries.9d35b05a10c1c64659fdb8bf6c53916c675b2fec: 1- Pays tribute to Agent Mohamed Lamine Berendouane who died to protect the Montreal population, and commits himself to perpetuating his memory so that his courage and sacrifice will never be forgotten;
entries.55ec76a06503bdf2a562ad340a2a112f33f86508: 2- offers its deepest condolences to the family of Agent Benredouane, his relatives and his colleagues in the SPVM;
entries.127bf2eb1e4ca1c750eb8c901c2cc1f988834094: 3- also offers its deepest condolences to the family and relatives of Mr. Michel Mizrahi, a citizen engaged and appreciated in his community who died during the shooting;
entries.e883db8476babc3541bb2bdf6510342c1cde922e: 4- salutes the courage, strength and dedication of the police officer seriously injured in the tragedy, Sergeant Xavier Gaumond, as well as all SPVM officers and police;
entries.018ee4d5c5869b3bd7feacd3ec8d56bf8c01b863: 5- condemns all acts and forms of violence, and reiterates that it is a city of peace where respect and openness to each other are fundamental values;
entries.6a6d6dbf5922999b18a1a5158270f41c8ef0f7c0: 6- Continue its efforts to combat violence and protect the security of Montrealers.
entries.0d67c069a6f7b0847f7dec535f56b6f00535d422: Whereas on 22 June 2026 a man opened fire in the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce and police officer Mohamed Lamine Benredouane died in the performance of his duties;
entries.c697c1dbd01cbaa19b5024d25b1e33c454f8b34c: Whereas, during this tragic event, Agent Benredouane made the ultimate sacrifice in a gesture of courage and dedication aimed at protecting the Montreal population as well as its partner, a police officer seriously injured during the shooting;
entries.74caa57d1d158b3d915b454730fe47fd70553c39: Whereas Agent Benredouane was a father of the family who had chosen to devote his life to his community, which he served with integrity, loyalty and generosity;
entries.e8b961fe54f7d84ab6445ab69ddff641e82a8c71: Whereas Agent Benredouane is the first officer of the City of Montreal Police Service (SPVM) who has died on duty since 2002;
entries.52ffb2670894e8e1d0f6c43859d5505162a6f302: Whereas Mr. Michel Mizrahi was also fatally hit by the shooter as he courageously tried to assist Agent Benredouane and his partner, thus posing a gesture of great bravery and solidarity that deserves to be emphasized and honoured;
entries.b0311d6d6cbfa39a674565ee14d6caddfcb95c0e: Whereas Mr. Michel Mizrahi, a family father and deeply committed member of the Montreal Jewish community, was recognized for his sense of dedication, generosity and constant desire to help others;
entries.a8903709240ee5d5d8bc91693962d880120da2bc: Whereas the shooting in Montreal in the Côte-des-Neiges district is a tragedy that will mark the history of the metropolis, and whereas the courageous and altruistic intervention of Agent Mohamed Lamine Berendouane, his partner, Sergeant Xavier Gaumond and many SPVM police officers sent to the scene commands the deepest respect and gratitude;
entries.f974e1383509ca08b9b659807ae3a5672b20f600: Whereas police officers make the choice of a profession with enormous risks and they and they agree daily to expose themselves to danger in order to ensure the safety and well-being of citizens, demonstrating exceptional commitment to serving the public;
entries.a6d5c2bb59e9caa090c567c2570fb62e68e63d4a: Whereas the City of Montreal is a city of peace based on benevolence and solidarity where violence has no place and takes concrete steps to prevent and actively combat violence.

entries.3553540037cb4b7e3e7831605bf121cce59ac06e: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Stephanie Valenzuela for the presentation of the Declaration.
entries.671ce0c115fe1802dd69a8ad278bc39c4b8d8149: At the outset, Ms. Valenzuela paid tribute to Agent Mohamed Lamine Benredouane and highlighted the courage and sense of duty shown by police officers in the City of Montreal Police Service (SPVM) and offered her condolences to her family, loved ones and colleagues.
entries.af7b83ce2c4eb0b89106b4d2d447599cedba0999: She said that the tragedy of June 22 marked Montreal deeply and noted that Agent Benredouane had lost his life while protecting the community, as well as the bravery of her partner, colleagues and Mr. Michel Mizrahi, who had lost his life trying to help.
entries.fe974585d214205ded7318b9ac158f5753d767d2: In closing, Ms Valenzuela thanked the members of Neighbourhood 26 post, as well as all police officers for their daily commitment and dedication to the public.
entries.5fd8b3e602393da7bb6086ac6d5eed5e6bfc9f80: The Chair of the Board gave the floor consecutively to Councillor Émilie Brière, Chief of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus, and then to Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada of Montreal.
entries.ae17c9de46ef60e29094cb6428d47f5e0b437b25: In the same spirit, Councillor Émilie Brière reports that in the days following June 22, several members of the Jewish community went to the grave of Agent Benredouane to lay flowers and gather there. In her view, this momentum of solidarity demonstrates the strength of the community in the face of pain.
entries.f4da66ef844c67c58b563bfba8dc6a3da236ce9d: She also felt that collective healing remained essential, particularly in the Côte-des-Neiges neighbourhood, which was hard hit by events. Ms. Briere said that the mobilization observed was an eloquent testimony to the resilience of the Montreal population.
entries.ae43c35e38a69034bd5dcc5aa9e33d5a4ecba7fb: Speaking in turn, Ericka Alneus, head of the Official Opposition, offered her condolences to the families of the two victims. She said that Mr. Mizrahi had dedicated his life to serving his religious community, while Agent Benredouane had served the Montreal population within the SPVM. She conveyed a message of courage to the police officer injured during this tragedy.
entries.5fc9b9caaf2b3e90b5b17985412cc845d4d95e89: Addressing families, she said that both victims embodied what Montreal had the best.
entries.d999040f6fdee78bd9cb6b05a90a30d74e26c298: Then, the Mayor of Montreal presents her most sincere condolences to the families, loved ones and all those affected by this tragedy. She affirms that it is difficult to imagine the extent of the pain caused by such loss and reaffirms that Montreal is mourning two of its own today. She also invites the public to remember their journey, their commitment and the sacrifice they have made in serving their community.
entries.194b2c705a12a0a512ecba33f8be5986731fa246: The Mayor of Montreal insists that Mr. Mizrahi and Agent Benredouane have dedicated their lives to others, leaving a legacy of generosity, dedication and commitment, and that their memory will continue to inspire the Montreal community.
entries.1f3902dfb4573db40b37c72b29458f708c09e669: On behalf of the City of Montreal, the Mayor of Montreal thanked the families for their presence and courage in this terrible ordeal. She assured them that the City of Montréal was supportive of their mourning and would preserve the memory of the victims.
entries.c6b906e328fc7c5dde44e317862272dfd8c3c009: In closing, she would like to invite members of the Board and those present to observe a moment of recollection in their memory.
entries.4916f2e06acc54c8a1bfbe665dee1c7e0b838abe: The chair of the council invited the assembly to rise so that members could gather in silence in memory of the victims.
entries.08f2303f0a13314c75d8507182e56cdf550bd490: Finally, it confirms the names of all members present on the municipal council as supporters of this Declaration.
entries.f0c2e705f316c65e393b61d4a57b07718b98f21b: 1- condemns in the strongest terms the femicides that have taken place in Montreal since the beginning of the year, and more broadly, the 13 femicides committed in Quebec in 2026, especially those of August 15 and 17, 2026 in the districts of Saint-Michel and François-Perrault, and offers condolences to the families and relatives of the victims, particularly to the children affected by these tragedies;
entries.ab89f3be1fa661f48f9fa83e5f716f5c8aa2ff19: 2. Recognize the systemic nature of gender-based violence, the most extreme manifestation of which is femicide;
entries.d6e2ee699b59444b58c0b3e04163492e115a70a1: 3- mandate the Public Safety Commission to prepare an update on SPVM's practices with respect to domestic violence and femicides in order to better equip and support members of the police force, to hold a public consultation with community organizations, shelters and consultation tables concerned, and to assess the feasibility of extending to all boroughs an approach inspired by the Montréal-Nord Domestic Violence Collective Action Plan;
entries.ee0ac331b10b57ba30c70ae5b7230094235b0f39: 4- formally calls on the Government of Quebec to fund the creation of shelters for women victims of domestic violence, beyond the amounts already announced for the consolidation of existing houses;
entries.dcd39546cdfd74f2f8e0dc2f996d879dcd222cb0: 5- that this declaration be forwarded to the Minister of Homeland Security of Quebec, the Minister responsible for the Status of Women of Québec, the management of the Police Service of the City of Montreal, the Regroupement des maisons pour femmes victimes de violence conjugale, the Table de concertation en violence conjugale de Montréal and the borough of Villeray–Saint-Michel– Parc-Extension.
entries.2209645d7134d96ae0ac0c115d4992c631131267: Whereas two femicides occurred in the district of Saint-Michel and the district of François-Perrault on 15 and 17 August 2026, during which Leakkhena Seng, 44 years old, and Kerline Jean, 41 years old, died in less than 72 hours;
entries.9925fd464e7d605cc7a6d4b82299271ae7b5a88e: Whereas five femicides have been perpetrated in Montreal since the beginning of 2026;
entries.f1e9caaa714f1c5bdeefeea2d4b299f1e9c0eb74: Whereas more and more women are subjected to violence, poverty and lower wages despite equivalent skills, and that racialized, immigrant, refugee, disabled, elderly, indigenous or community-based 2SLGBTQIA+ women are at greater risk of systemic discrimination;
entries.78712946baeb97536846ca3b0aead48f40a24c54: Whereas gender-based violence remains a reality affecting women in all walks of life and particularly affects women living in situations of vulnerability;
entries.b6364556ea345b283529f44955ec26929180b2ac: Whereas femicide is the most extreme manifestation of gender-based violence and constitutes a fundamental violation of women's rights, security and dignity;
entries.66b3dc36e8058dfc0f9b565463848d51b79a7ff7: Whereas in 2026 Quebec experienced a worrying acceleration in the number of femicides, recalling the urgent need to strengthen preventive and protective measures against women at risk;
entries.13a55dc3f51cf683e0f32fbe9eca3f88c2f700a1: Whereas shelters, community organizations and front-line resources play an essential role in the protection of women and children victims of domestic violence;
entries.d65f515c374e7e78483d23aa97473f2e9c1a9e7e: Whereas more than half of the requests for accommodation addressed to SOS Domestic violence cannot be filled due to lack of space and that housing in the Montreal area must refuse a significant proportion of eligible applications;
entries.badc5b87c9893e813c9212114c535c0d30b6ce46: Whereas women's safety is an issue that directly affects citizens in all neighbourhoods of Montreal, without exception;
entries.bb497c8b26a1c36596ae69c6dd796cade69d5105: Whereas the City of Montreal, through its services, boroughs, the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal (SPVM) and its community partnerships, has important levers to help prevent domestic violence and support victims.
entries.4054728521b066288e6f8d3990647099574e5e01: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Caroline Braun for the presentation of the Declaration.
entries.9235a650747c046542dedbc716e5e1a1d0f27436: At the outset, Ms. Braun indicated that on August 13, 2026, five femicides had been identified in Montreal and thirteen in Quebec. She highlighted the essential role of front-line organizations providing assistance to victims of violence, while regretting their underfunding. In this regard, 41,000 applications for help from vulnerable women had reportedly been refused in the past year.
entries.81078d5e2030d7174d234da8167d672103cf5fad: In addition, she notes that women's right to vote remains relatively recent in Quebec and that their access to elected office, such as mayor or prime minister, is even more important. Despite these advances, women remain the main victims of domestic violence and, according to her, femicide is the most extreme form of this violence, requires urgent action, as well as increased support for front-line resources, particularly emergency shelters.
entries.31d366c42dbca8a17652c8dd6f72299199e56276: In conclusion, she condemned femicides and considered that underfunding of aid resources might force some victims to remain in a violent environment or to find themselves in an even more precarious situation; she called for recognition of the systemic nature of violence against women and for strengthening governmental support to the agencies concerned.
entries.e10c53edae4e82944b9632c98e9a8ac382793951: The Chair gave the floor consecutively to Councillor Sylvain Ouellet and Councillor Carla Beauvais.
entries.aa98badb5dfc301d00d14fb356efcd99dde4c3b2: Councillor Sylvain Ouellet mentioned that the harsh reality of femicides affected him particularly, since two femicides had occurred in his district in less than six months. He therefore cited a intervener's comments and argued that emergency services were quick to intervene during a fire or situation involving an active shooter, whereas a woman fearing for her safety could be denied access to a shelter due to lack of available places.In his view, such situations constituted unacceptable human tragedies which should not exist in a society like ours.
entries.ad2d0adb14db7617cdc5c7d583a6082b6bc92545: Then, Councillor Carla Beauvais paid tribute to Leakkhena Seng, 44, and Kerline Jean, 41, victims of femicides in the Saint-Michel district. She deplored the fact that attention paid to such tragedies quickly faded when they occurred in certain circles and felt that this silence increased the gravity of the tragedy. She also referred to the fact that Ms. Jean's children had witnessed the murder of their mother, an experience whose repercussions would follow them all their lives. Beyond the slogan "Not one more", she said that it was necessary to break the silence surrounding these situations and continue reflection on the measures to be put in place.
entries.d2db7d255a6db8fae17089cb4953001caf0a7054: It concludes by asking that a moment of silence be observed in their memory.

entries.73cf5cbf60bde17163befc84f859333b90a39bed: 2. Reaffirms its determination to combat all forms of racism and systemic discrimination faced by black people, while promoting their social, economic and cultural development, and that it will continue to do so through the establishment of a new action plan;
entries.17a9ecd8ae900f34cd25b4a8515f030997701a91: 3- Welcomes the essential work of all Afro-descendant groups working hard to combat anti-black racism and ensure recognition of the commemoration of the transatlantic trade in black people.
entries.5a62cdc6a2c0e297682e9e9d79dc62acbb335886: Whereas on 23 August 1791 the insurrection began, during which people enslaved in Santo Domingo, today the Republic of Haiti, claimed their freedom, and that this insurrection played a decisive role in the abolition of the transatlantic trade in black persons;
entries.3f50a16da1dbe9cca3bba05edeccf69242c20748: Whereas in 1998 UNESCO established the International Day of Remembrance of the Transatlantic Black Trade and its Abolition;
entries.4e6b3e854f65a5d3a8300f7882fe0132a9a0f285: Whereas this day is a call to combat all forms of servitude, racism, prejudice, racial discrimination and social injustice while constituting an essential duty of remembrance;
entries.20374ac7dcbe077b0051d043f665b9413c6e259b: Whereas the United Nations General Assembly proclaimed the International Decade for People of African Descent from 2015 to 2024, in the hope of eradicating social injustices inherited from trafficking in black people, and whereas a second decade, from 2025 to 2034, was adopted recognizing that people of African descent represent a distinct group whose human rights must be promoted and protected;
entries.7a3133d9a22640f8fafdfb9d12ca0ef57a666455: Whereas the City of Montreal has committed itself to combating all forms of discrimination by adopting the Montreal Declaration against Racial Discrimination (1989), the Montreal Declaration for Cultural Diversity and Inclusion (2004), the Montreal Declaration on Living Together (2015) and the Declaration to Recognize the Systemic Nature of Racism and Discrimination and to Commit to Combat It (2020);
entries.bd9a03f2221f359eb27f4e5a0cdab4590fdb516c: Whereas the City of Montreal is taking concrete steps to establish an administration that promotes equity in all its different forms while actively combating racism, systemic discrimination and profiling;
entries.923fe6e3057fff537bc86d1be284886170b02ac9: Whereas the City of Montreal is firmly committed to ensuring that black people are safe in the metropolis and can flourish fully there, that they are well represented in the City and included at all levels of the Montréal public service;
entries.cf3c51b7a97933b5ffa21735862b252c427e053b: Whereas the mosaic of cultural communities that make up Montreal is one of its greatest strengths, a wealth to protect which defines it and which is part of both its history and its development.

entries.85f334d663ff3c813d855857434a8f2198086bf3: The Chair of the Council, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Josué Corvil for the presentation of the Declaration and then to the Chief of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus.
entries.c7e9f881ce03dce6d973699df977de9924b2f0ac: From the outset, Councillor Josué Corvil celebrates International Day of Remembrance of the slave trade as a duty of remembrance that is imposed on this dark page of history. He describes slavery as a monumental mistake that has deracted millions of African people from their homeland and subjected them to servitude and violence, while colonial powers have privileged their economic interests to the detriment of human values. He recounts the period when slaves took charge of their destiny during the ceremony of the Cayman Wood, leading to the general revolt of slaves in the French colony and, finally, to the creation of the first Black Republic of the world in Haiti, in 1804.
entries.12c249879c87300aed65d11e0395e78ffd2f1915: Mr Corvil stressed the importance of recognizing slavery as a crime against humanity and that it was essential to continue to draw inspiration from past mistakes in order to correct and redress them. He concluded by thanking the members of the League of Blacks present on the balcony and invited the Council to adopt unanimously the Declaration to mark International Day of Remembrance of the Transatlantic Traffic in Black Persons and its abolition.
entries.dc7cd2fd4282b217315c7dee1f54bffb92747313: In her turn, the leader of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus, said that she was emotionally supportive of the Declaration to mark the International Day of Remembrance of the Transatlantic Trade in Black Persons and its Abolition, not only as head of the Official Opposition, but as a child of this tragedy which marked humanity. She also shared the importance of the duty of collective memory and resistance for the freedom, integrity and dignity of individuals. She recalled that the soup of independence, celebrated on January 1st in Haiti, symbolized the courage and determination of a people who had conquered their freedom. Ms. Alneus concluded by saying that this story allowed us to measure the way they had travelled, while today she could sit as elected municipal.
entries.5d608eb1048a4bb1df29e49eb77e847d78ff5a1b: The Chair thanked the two elected representatives for their interventions and confirmed the names of all members present on the City Council as supporters of this Declaration.
entries.6dc15d6b797da753c41801e34eeeaa596bb88d1f: 1- that the City of Montreal proudly celebrates the 60th anniversary of the Montréal metro, an exceptional achievement that has profoundly marked its history, shaped its development and contributed to its identity;
entries.d353dd59a6ff57c20f557f1e3ff2f16e74340d46: 2- that the municipal council pay tribute to all those who, from its conception until today, have imagined, built, operated, maintained, modernized and developed this emblematic network for the benefit of the population;
entries.ddb2a5056795ff2b7bda41c937156f5de48b0f97: 3- that the City of Montreal and the Société de transport de Montréal continue their efforts to provide the population with a modern, accessible, safe, reliable and welcoming metro that meets the expectations of Montrealers;
entries.5438cb19ce63ea0920d2ecf4e9e308943208b83c: 4- that the municipal council reiterate to the governments of Quebec and Canada the importance of ensuring predictable, sustainable and sufficient funding for the maintenance, modernization, expansion and sustainability of the Montreal metro;
entries.f66be02ab49c7f05d72c69bd45c82769116da804: 5- that the City Council invites all Montrealers to proudly mark the 60th anniversary of the Montréal metro and to pay tribute to all those who have contributed to its success for 60 years;
entries.e6bd7c27e3731d7f7267dc35c3698959a0fcebe7: 6- that the municipal council reaffirm its commitment to a modern, safe, accessible, reliable and sustainable metro network, and recognize that the preservation of this collective heritage is a shared responsibility, essential for the future of Montreal and the metropolitan area.
entries.d3a4f0d834ada519382d9034aba6d7511cf0f999: Whereas the Montreal metro is celebrating its 60th anniversary this year;
entries.06c0868dd93ab25b28f52999c8ef710db6152873: Whereas its construction was undertaken in 1962 under the administration of Mayor Jean Drapeau and the Chairman of the Executive Committee, Lucien Saulnier, who had made it a priority for the future of Montreal;
entries.e38393faf580519a37f25a4d4a72dd51d0654147: Whereas the initial network of 26 stations was carried out on time and within planned budgets, under the direction of the Metro Office headed by engineer Lucien L'Allier;
entries.f1e19ddc12a29b59b80648f3e509b3dc9057d014: Whereas the Montreal metro was inaugurated on October 14, 1966, in the presence of many dignitaries and nearly half a million Montrealers who came to celebrate this historic achievement;
entries.5e4a6388e9b6c598af7fc7c0af3d51100a01bcb8: Whereas its operation was entrusted to the Commission de transport de Montréal, today the Société de transport de Montréal (STM), which has been providing essential service to the population for 60 years;
entries.e18c70acf6433d0852eef7f84497c7ebbf712224: Whereas the network was expanded by 39 stations in the 1970s and 1980s thanks to the Metropolitan Transportation Office, under the direction of engineer Gérard Gascon;
entries.ccbf20ac79d993bea060399e895ec43ba0756a04: Whereas three new stations were inaugurated in Laval in 2007, bringing the network to 68 stations;
entries.8e6b525f7363492fa5282237a4719bd1524b423a: Whereas five new stations on the Blue Line are currently under construction thanks to commitment and financial support from governments and their partners;
entries.ced175e48f072b7fa9001c810720da6ac88165e8: Whereas, since its commissioning, the Montreal metro has allowed more than 11 billion trips, contributing every week to the mobility of millions of people;
entries.be11f00c36955ed6f540358c60ab723d81ab888f: Whereas the Montreal metro was a pioneer in offering unique architecture for each of its stations and integrating public art into its network;
entries.1405ae985a2aea33f2c4e7e803ff580d12a33414: Whereas the Montreal Metro is the first fully pneumatic metro network in North America, an innovation that marked its era;
entries.78cd62d40312812a1b9b90a0e40cffb93e722abc: Whereas it has contributed significantly to the economic, urban and cultural development of Montreal, in particular to the growth of the city centre and the underground city;
entries.26430139d95a2d35ee004830c5c7bc24089bc5a0: Whereas it has played a key role in the success of major international events, including the 1967 Universal Exhibition and the 1976 Olympic Games;
entries.69df78a1d130359a0f173622ba6308b8d22b058a: Whereas it is a pillar of sustainable mobility and an essential ecological alternative to automobiles;
entries.79921daeb5117d7e5a9d9ba3ff9e2e4aba4b8b7c: Whereas it has become a symbol of modernity, innovation and Montreal identity;
entries.c2a8f43708d633116d09b7467734e61f879256fc: Whereas he is proud of the women and men who have imagined, built, maintained, exploited and borrowed him for six decades now;
entries.d5d11ebe6d49aa4675cd9865c5b14e38119d2373: Whereas the team expertise, the innovation required and the operating model have inspired several metro networks around the world;
entries.0ceaeaf21fa02d3e4e561b6b9208d1513627abeb: Whereas it plays an essential role in the economic, social and cultural vitality of Montreal and the entire metropolitan area;
entries.3f1515118e95872f7d0fe3168ae65bc7cfb73ee6: Whereas it is the backbone of an extensive integrated mobility network comprising STM buses, suburban trains and the Metropolitan Express Network (MEN);
entries.45ea034a3ab3e4f688c7a51deac1da76b5e74937: Whereas after 60 years of service, the metro faces the challenge of ageing its infrastructure and requires major investments to ensure its sustainability, reliability, safety and development for future generations;
entries.954e96b909bfdab10c1a55fc7085ccb653a83291: Whereas the Montreal metro remains one of the largest collective heritages in the city, is at the heart of its identity, development and outreach, and its future is a shared responsibility between the City of Montréal, the Government of Quebec and the Government of Canada.
entries.e74b9d30a530df1f3a4b7c0b6384f089487ffb03: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Aref Salem for the presentation of the Declaration and then to Councillor Sarah V. Doyon.
entries.84ecd622f969608ca799d22031c3099117dfe47a: First, Mr. Salem presents the Montreal Transportation Corporation's sweater, which he proudly wears to mark the 60th anniversary of the Montréal Metro. He is delighted to see the elected people gathered around this symbol and affirms that the metro is a source of collective pride for the Montreal population.
entries.b0c617dfbb666d99b7abf20380501ce2c5d32d72: It indicates, among other things, that the realization of the metro stems from the ambitious vision of Jean Drapeau's administration, supported by Lucien Saulnier, who wanted to make Montreal a modern and innovative metropolis. Inaugurated in 1966 after the project was launched in 1962, the network quickly became a central element of Montréal's urban development, an essential service characterized by a distinctive architecture of its stations, including public art.
entries.a4b2fdbe356a9ea3969861dfec1a0258fb09e193: In conclusion, he pointed out that the metro is now part of Montreal's DNA. He stressed the importance of preserving this heritage and continuing its modernization, beyond partisan considerations, so that future generations can be as proud of it as those who benefit from it today.
entries.e7598ce70fcb268620bab69c6abdcce244fcca03: Councillor Sarah V. Doyon continues and thanks the Société de transport de Montréal for the commemorative sweater marking the 60th anniversary of Montreal's metro. She highlights the emblematic character of the old subway cars, which bear witness to the history of the network. Continuing her speech, she evokes the era of major projects that led to the creation of the first tyre metro in North America. She highlights the fundamental role of this infrastructure in the daily lives of the population. She also stresses the importance of maintaining the network and making it accessible to all, recalling that only 30 of the 68 stations are currently universally accessible.
entries.a8b78dccb9b611e0eda5123d4afcbc90183e6610: In closing, she pointed out that the metro connects neighbourhoods, promotes travel and has profoundly transformed Montréal. She said that this is Canada's largest public transit infrastructure, with nearly 800,000 trips per day. Welcoming future-oriented projects, including interurban mobility, she called on decision makers and the public to show ambition in developing the metropolitan transportation network.
entries.ee353b6688c92ff6db6e24dfd8dd74f3c30740b1: to recommend to the municipal council:

entries.4c8952a012764aff45aa531553872090fc7894d4: 1 - that the City of Montreal reaffirm its commitment to the values of peace, respect for fundamental rights, security and dignity for all;
entries.c182cc7e06f281748342561fbd24c77315d105b5: 2 - that the City of Montreal reiterate the importance of combating all forms of hatred, including anti-Semitism and Islamophobia;
entries.f7125150f1f2030e318539290134cb5e722eccd0: 3 - that the City of Montreal recognizes and denounces the apartheid regime imposed in Palestine and the genocide perpetrated there and affirms its solidarity with the Palestinian people and all civilian victims of hostilities in West Asia, commonly referred to as the Middle East;
entries.bf9b17ddb097e6f6e9746ba2b6ba66c5e8cae9ce: 4 - that the municipal council reaffirm that the Jewish communities of Montreal and elsewhere, as well as persons of Israeli origin, cannot be held responsible for the actions of the State of Israel and that these communities themselves face a worrying rise in anti-Semitism;
entries.b8ad854240b16754e3047fc220b2779785f9e7a2: 5 - that, in a spirit of coherence and respect for international law, the City Council request the City of Montreal to suspend without further delay its institutional ties with the current government of Israel, its institutions and municipalities, including by ceasing to invite representatives of that State to attend official events held at the City Hall of Montreal, until Israel returns to its internationally recognized borders, cease its violations of the rights of the Palestinian people and end its violations of international law;
entries.582a5a6d173938e47db28a13ba814a5e24418797: 6 - that the municipal council communicate this position to the governments of Quebec and Canada.
entries.c2f4065fd72e64b93723cacd3abe431f91ed3595: Whereas the City of Montreal is distinguished by the diversity of its population and by its commitment to welcoming, including and respecting people of immigrant origin;
entries.20cea6e5be99617b814acc2c14a21f11f9ea4f9d: Whereas, as a member of the international network of Cities Mayors for Peace, the promotion of peace, human dignity, respect for human rights and living together constitutes a foundation for the municipal action of the City of Montreal;
entries.8f7b1d9c3c831b595e6de31f4f6e452ba0644bcb: Whereas the City of Montreal is committed to combating racism and discrimination, as well as to promoting harmonious intercultural relations with respect and understanding by adopting, inter alia, the Montreal Declaration against Racial Discrimination, the Montreal Declaration for Cultural Diversity and Inclusion, the Declaration to Recognize the Systemic Nature of Racism and Discrimination and the Montreal Charter of Rights and Responsibilities;
entries.ee0b49bf77314e78695bc17066702b2898568341: Whereas the City of Montreal has historically taken a stand against regimes of segregation and oppression, notably by officially opposing South African apartheid in 1989 and welcoming President Nelson Mandela four months after his release;
entries.1f882e7fa7c6def5d93ed31e8bdbd06f2630494d: Whereas the hostilities currently taking place in several territories, including Palestine, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen, Iran, Israel and Qatar, affect civilian populations and plunge these peoples and their diasporas, particularly in Montreal, into a period of uncertainty, fear and mourning;
entries.5a7778e1046ab932336ebb949cfabefd52f6b390: Whereas the attacks by Hamas against Israeli civilians on 7 October 2023 led to unanimous international condemnation;
entries.1edb67ee2ef4bb042601496fbb1c9c1103aa3212: Whereas since 7 October 2023 armed hostilities in Palestine, Israel and neighbouring regions have resulted in the deaths of tens of thousands of people, the vast majority of whom are civilians, including a high number of children, women, humanitarian personnel, relief workers, medical personnel and journalists;
entries.5357becb9e41e7ebedcd666167bda80e34395252: Whereas many people of Palestinian origin and other countries affected by such hostilities reside throughout Montreal, work there and actively engage in it, contributing significantly to its social, cultural, scientific and economic vitality;
entries.002b76cea6bddff3132c43e0619a0da14793489d: Whereas several recognized international human rights organizations, such as Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch, but also bodies of genocide experts, including the International Association of Genocide Scholars and the Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention, describe the actions of the Israeli government in Palestine as genocide, genocide or extermination;
entries.425119212b4b396394d64753a17dd15d5b298183: Whereas many Israeli human rights organizations, including B'Tselem, the largest of them, and Physicians for Human Rights - Israel, recognize that Israel is currently maintaining an apartheid regime in Palestine;
entries.3eba84afaf8e8673470bed802a282966e348cf2e: Whereas the International Court of Justice recognized in 2024 that Israeli State policies and practices in the occupied Palestinian territories constitute segregation or apartheid, in violation of article 3 of the International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination and that the State of Israel is subject to formal charges of genocide before the International Court of Justice;
entries.e89bea354333946c628726c7f6c4682e91181d5c: Whereas the International Independent Investigation Commission in the Occupied Palestinian Territory issued a report on 25 September 2025 concluding that Israel is committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza and urging Israel and all States to fulfil their legal obligations to put an end to the genocide and punish those responsible;
entries.8bcf418860206123c7df8cb98258541f85683a62: Whereas the current Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, is subject to an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court for war crimes and crimes against humanity;
entries.75c70cdd3cc7debfcae62ad694708d40dd95b46c: Whereas the Prime Minister of Canada, Mark Carney, stated that under this arrest warrant Benjamin Netanyahu would be arrested if he entered Canadian territory;
entries.bd304f9959469f82da5b3f3673ed16c955bb9981: Whereas on September 21, 2025, the Prime Minister of Canada, Mark Carney, announced that Canada officially recognized the State of Palestine;
entries.4bd020ea6ee618c67fbba70846c26a967bbcbfff: Whereas the City Council has adopted numerous resolutions on international issues, including motions and declarations concerning human rights violations in Iran, Haiti, Rwanda, but also condemned the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022, notably by raising the Ukrainian flag at city hall and ceasing to invite Russian diplomats to municipal protocol events;
entries.e72e138640fc565453e14f94f1f5a8979be4149b: Whereas the City Council of March 23, 2026 of the City of Montreal adopted a declaration in support of the civilian victims of the attacks on Israel and the United States in Lebanon and Iran, reaffirmed its solidarity with the Lebanese people and with the entire Lebanese and Iranian community in Montreal and that at the same council, the City committed itself to continue the fight against anti-Semitism on the occasion of Holocaust Remembrance Day;
entries.dd99837adf82e99bff5e639277ea53f6af087fbb: Whereas, at a recent demonstration held in Montreal, certain actions were taken in a context of concern about the rise in hate crimes and that it is important to reaffirm that persons of Jewish or Israeli descent should not be held responsible for the actions of the State of Israel;
entries.1d58e89680bf26e91eca7234d07cbf662baf7a36: Whereas humanitarian aid vessels to Gaza were intercepted in May 2026 by Israeli forces in international waters, resulting in the arrest of civilians, including Canadian and Montrealers, and the Government of Canada expressed deep concern about their treatment, calling it "unacceptable" and "abominable";
entries.db4f35db0972e5a42ff98e685d53b2824164fd86: The chair of the board, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to the motion's proposer, Councillor Nathalie Goulet.
entries.bdd7aba79f408e9d157c1f9f859ee7ce849a09be: In the beginning, Ms. Goulet describes Montreal as a welcoming land, where thousands of people from all over the world have found refuge and peace, and where they have built their lives. And in all these families from all walks of life, there are sufferings going beyond borders. In this sense, it is a duty for her to recognize the genocide taking place in Palestine and to show solidarity with the Palestinian people and victims of the conflict in West Asia.
entries.a32ed1d26c3033531f207b778fd1ff519ac6828c: In particular, Ms. Goulet argues that cities can be raised as courageous voices like Montreal, which has been in the past. She believes that this opportunity presents itself here and that we have a responsibility to raise again by supporting this motion.
entries.13d440a73ad089ec1b60773285193c48c6a882c6: Councillor Alex Norris and Councillor Martine Musau Muele followed in support of this motion.
entries.64fc273591e356f5a045b45914799a7773637b34: In summary, Mr. Norris sets out a moral test for our time by referring to the atrocities committed in the destruction of Gaza over the past three years. According to him, the time has come to put an end to the double standards, and for that, Montreal must be consistent in condemning the war crimes perpetrated by Israel, and putting human rights and international laws ahead.
entries.b53ae76e86e1222d4920504bb6512f95e097c927: As for Councillor Martine Musau Muele, she shares three main reflections. First, she believes that there is only one camp where all are to be settled, it is peace. She continues by drawing on consistent actions which must accompany the values defended by the elected people. Then, she evokes a new paradigm in public policies where structural, institutional and cultural changes could take place, so as to give a voice to those who do not have any more.
entries.168a8e0132d36428892e7e8d3b3cefb0d9f62d18: Following a speech by the Mayor of Montreal, Soraya Martinez Ferrada. Around values that unite all, such as recognizing the sufferings resulting from war, protecting civilian populations, defending international law and wishing for a just and lasting peace in the world, the Mayor of Montreal questions the role and responsibilities of the city council, including: gathering, without importing the fractures of the world and without being silent. She is of the opinion that it is not necessary to substitute for the international institutions, created in order to give meaning and weight to these values then, consequences when they are not respected. She ends with the leadership of Montreal.
entries.c75d8b407badc66dc9cf244df197f4f5b8a9dcad: which must act on levers in its possession, for example by strengthening the prevention of hate crimes and intercultural dialogue.
entries.ad3f8834ffb2d6a1476cd96d041ed448ec9cff0f: The Chair thanked the four elected representatives for their interventions.

entries.c041cbf73f1135764cafc659102d97904e7423da: That the City Council express its solidarity with Montrealers whose families, families or communities are affected by the current conflicts in Palestine, Israel, Lebanon, Iran and elsewhere in the region;
entries.688abd8c48091e6fb6477c84d6bb7419fe99e8f4: That the municipal council reiterate the importance of combating all forms of hatred, including anti-Semitism and Islamophobia;
entries.57ee55a44a7e5c77b131742d1b1fdfc2bf9d7dea: That the City Council affirm its solidarity with the Palestinian people and all civilian victims of hostilities in West Asia, commonly referred to as the Middle East, reaffirm its commitment to respect for international law and international humanitarian law and support the work of relevant judicial bodies and international bodies responsible for examining allegations of violations of international law in the Gaza Strip, including ongoing proceedings before the International Court of Justice concerning the application and interpretation of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide;
entries.96cd08b9b7d9cd5e43cdca7b6ca31232a0705937: That the municipal council reaffirm that the Jewish communities of Montreal and elsewhere, as well as persons of Israeli origin, cannot be held responsible for the actions of the State of Israel and that these communities themselves face a worrying rise in anti-Semitism;
entries.73668ff68f0abf9b9c9d4bf89f099cd75495c128: That the municipal council call upon the Government of Canada and Quebec to demonstrate increased leadership in the peaceful resolution of the conflict, including through appropriate diplomatic mechanisms, respect for international law and sanctions against parties and individuals responsible for serious violations of international humanitarian and human rights law;
entries.2d961cfc6d4b1566ced63857d60dec725c26e987: That the City Council continue to support initiatives that promote dialogue, coexistence, public safety and mutual understanding between Montrealers;
entries.9de37897b2ab5c7e5606b4a2d4f23a6bebf36911: May the City Council reaffirm that Montreal remains deeply committed to the values of dialogue, inclusion, mutual respect and civil peace, and that it is a city where all people can live together in dignity, security and respect for their rights."

entries.4aa5703c518b593f1f3d8a0d4325bca8e1ee4d2c: Debate continues on the amended motion.
entries.d806bf44a4ca2c175b9d16b1b0d22817bd18453d: The President gave the floor to Ericka Alneus, Chief of the Official Opposition, and then to Soraya Martinez Ferrada, Mayor of Montreal.
entries.2082f15b20bd9ee160941d2b63871d094b5db1bd: to proceed to a show of hands vote on the amended motion.
entries.e60a125d106c71f999ea1959b6f8ccefd79d486e: The Chairperson of the Council put item 65.01, as amended, to the vote and the Board divided as follows:
entries.c91c6e66b4975c5df03a4b1d788f0e375519008d: 1- that the municipal council recognize the strategic importance of the expertise acquired within the Blue Line Extension Project Office, as well as potentially that of the "Lisette" tunnel operator for future metro projects in the metropolitan area;
entries.87554e314e037680b797df7f9671e78df66778f2: 2- that the municipal council ask the Government of Quebec to evaluate all options to preserve the expertise acquired within the project office from the extension of the line
entries.1398e3ef7dc10c753ea69b85fea5b83af24b811f: study the conditions for retaining the "Lisette" tunnel operator in Montreal following completion of the blue line extension;
entries.92735b844399f40e583517b5b992ff02f7089da3: 3- the economic, technical and environmental benefits associated with the reuse of this equipment for future metro projects or other underground public transport infrastructure;
entries.e124854d04c68bc5fd9b45c299cbeb4d277e7564: 4- that the City Council invite the Government of Quebec, the Regional Metro Transport Authority, the Société de transport de Montréal and other relevant partners to work together to identify metro extension projects that may benefit from the re-use of the tunnel operator;
entries.143a9b402cfb9c5f77469208a06420a6896181af: 5- that the municipal council reiterate the urgent need to ensure the maintenance of Montreal metro assets in order to guarantee the continuation of its services and that it can continue to play its central role in the vitality and mobility of the metropolis;
entries.2ce2a8660754c3ef43bd8043449a1fbf06fa5ca2: 6- the municipal council reiterates the importance of continuing the development of public transport networks in the metropolitan area in order to meet the growing needs for mobility and support the ecological transition;
entries.b5ed42e8048eb7f6deb1e42ccd2339beb3875c79: 7- that the municipal council recognize the pioneering role of Lisette St-Onge, the first woman operator of the Montreal metro;
entries.e95aba346eeadd8802ead7d58b8c2602eb618073: 8- that the municipal council transmit a copy of this motion to the Government of Quebec and to the public transportation agencies and organizations in the Montréal metropolitan area.
entries.dcf0e760d7aa3160f94feb7b9b5e75728cf320fa: The Leader of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus, and Councillor Aref Salem tabled a new consensus version of 65.02. The new version reads as follows:
entries.b87d899c8e7cdab31ed48d1b879cc9825e825e82: Whereas the Montréal metro provides 62% of public transit movements in the metropolitan area and is the most daily transportation equipment in Canada;
entries.cf224e6c56d985e497cf2628ac955a3f8229d300: Whereas the extension of the blue metro line is one of the most important public transit projects currently being carried out in Quebec;
entries.f88ec318292b18271483c0c08745c0f4a2b4a9bd: Whereas the tunneller used to excavate the blue line extension, nicknamed "Lisette", represents specialized equipment designed to be tailored for the specific needs of the Montreal soil type whose acquisition, transport and commissioning involve considerable costs;
entries.2b6a22b81f448f1f7f0503cf58152a0c7fc607da: Whereas excavation work on the blue line extension must be completed around 2028;
entries.8fd2d022ce2fd147569133fffa7fa392da2ab58f: Whereas the development and maintenance of Quebec expertise in public transit projects is a strategic lever to better control costs and accelerate the implementation of new projects;
entries.57983e5493dcd28a7078d9cdbb5ba35d87682542: Whereas several structural public transport projects are envisaged or under study in the metropolitan area and will require major investments in the coming decades;
entries.2814551f919ed17ec08905b6c17b2c48d2af3553: Whereas 46% of Montreal's metro assets are in poor or very poor condition and nearly $10 billion in investments in the maintenance of metro assets required over the next 10 years are still not funded;
entries.aeb4c26d952f316f6fe3f2268ad24ac0aeacc661: Whereas on May 19, 2026, when the excavation of the Montreal Blue Line extension was launched, the Mayor of Montreal, Soraya Martinez Ferrada, called upon all political parties to commit themselves to keeping the tunneler in operation after the completion of the work under way, arguing that this is a measure of sound governance and good administration that allows for continuous planning and implementation of public transportation projects;
entries.db9a465a96f917410a8ac3e45438055e7560587e: Whereas the Mayor of Montreal, Soraya Martinez Ferrada, recalled at the Climate Summit in April 2026 that "the transition also involves structural choices, and collective transport is part of it";
entries.c864c0879764ebadabbc0b2c24b9519007f777ac: Whereas the Mayor of Montreal also stated that "collective transportation is an essential lever to reduce our emissions, improve mobility and make the transition accessible to all";
entries.d4831d3ed4f662e285df23550f249dde861d4ac6: Whereas the development of public transport networks is an indispensable tool for responding to climate challenges, road congestion and the growth of the metropolitan area;
entries.6518dd3ce33b9c283fddaf64f2a4bd4d3f1d9545: Whereas the conservation and reuse of strategic equipment can help to optimize the use of public funds and reduce costs associated with carrying out future infrastructure projects;
entries.4ae05be899dab03481d7444942aabeccdfc0bc1b: Whereas several municipal and metropolitan actors have stressed the value of assessing the re-use possibilities of the tunnel operator for future metro extension projects;
entries.d0b62925dac8de6e390afded50604f0c8e01bc14: Whereas predictable and continuous planning of major projects helps to preserve the expertise developed, reduce lead times and costs while maximising public investment;
entries.7c22cb59b693a4f5b6af074be8e03b8ef5bc2ebd: The Chair of the Council, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to the motion leader, Ericka Alneus, of the Official Opposition.
entries.f69aca104ba21aec3ff429491da0dd44f5e278ec: In particular, Ms. Alneus mentioned that the motion was intended to encourage a long-term vision of the development of public transit in Montreal, particularly in the east of the city, by inviting decision makers to go beyond electoral cycle considerations, and that it was her view that the implementation of structural projects was based on decades-long planning. She then put forward the investments already made for the Lisette tunnel operator as well as its potential to support future metro projects. Finally, she stressed the importance of taking advantage of this opportunity to further develop the collective transportation network and meet the mobility needs of residents of eastern Montreal.
entries.7dba63967b27d0e2ff6301c0bbce9cab3dfd4eec: The Chair thanked her and then gave the floor to Councillor Sarah V. Doyon.
entries.3add4772afe4df3b0740f1925c0d956e20b26335: Councillor Sarah V. Doyon first highlighted the opportunity of the tunneler Lisette, currently used for the extension of the blue line, considering that it would be preferable to keep it in order to continue the work, notably to connect the green and blue lines and improve mobility in the east of the city.
entries.841a08ebe4d1e42a15db49c12e809a8dd2a28fff: In addition, it argues that the development of the metro network must continue in parallel with the investments needed to maintain existing infrastructure. It also stresses that the continuation of new projects would help to preserve the expertise acquired, consolidate specialized teams and reduce certain costs associated with the realization of future construction sites. Finally, it invites Council members to adopt a long-term vision of public transport by planning now the next phases of expansion of the network, both in the east and in other areas of Montreal.
entries.ae6920f1a2fcfc9bfb361337484463958a29f9c8: At 3:46 p.m., the Chair of Council, Chantal Rossi, left the presidential chair and gave way to the Vice-Chair of Council, Émilie Brière.
entries.97ef4a09561872ed04fdd9ee51812dd4c43b865a: Vice-Chair, Émilie Brière, gave the floor to Councillor Céline-Audrey Beauregard.
entries.42aa5c7a84e62c553c4a93665066746e1e035623: Ms. Beauregard pointed out that mobility needs would continue to grow, particularly in the Greater Southwest, where several sectors were expected to develop and accommodate new residents.
entries.c3f29393bdce1903588c62ec85a6b35645fabe1d: In addition, it refers to the displacement challenges facing the population of this territory, in particular due to the distances to be travelled, the required connections and the presence of significant physical barriers. From this perspective, it considers that the preservation of the tunnel operator would help maintain options for future structuring projects and promote better connectivity between the various sectors of Montreal.
entries.9f8af426e551dd5b57980252b39998229d6a83d9: At 3:51 p.m., the president of the council, Chantal Rossi, took over the presidential chair.
entries.19c5c6cb3a8c6fc76c63b4e487b96043e96627fd: The Chair of the Board, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Nancy Blanchet, who shared her colleagues' views on the obvious needs for collective transportation in Montreal's Greater Southwest arrondissements.
entries.773bc900347cef9a09039d773870de6095133412: Finally, the President gave the floor to the Administration's spokesperson for this matter, Councillor Aref Salem.
entries.9d768bb2bf0dc52fa73255be47ff1fbf358457c8: At the outset, Mr. Salem supported the spirit of the original motion and indicated that the new version of the motion was intended to clarify certain elements, in particular that the Mayor of Montreal had already mentioned at the launch of the Lisette tunneler the possibility of retaining this equipment for future public transport projects.
entries.b1d7089ec41a54ede107ddabe93642251486cef9: He then mentioned the investments required to maintain the assets of the metro network and the importance of preserving this equipment for future generations. He therefore believed in the need to retain the expertise developed as part of the extension of the blue line, recalling the needs expressed in several sectors of the metropolis in terms of structuring public transport. In conclusion, he acknowledged the importance of obtaining a government commitment allowing further development of the network.
entries.62fca4646e3a9cc50367314daa4d397e2cecb0ee: At 4:01 p.m., the Chair suspended work for a break.
entries.7f05d00d3013e9f0dc2982b5f929ae019d8d50a6: At 4:18 p.m., Council resumed its work and official Opposition leader Marie Plourde confirmed that the new version of motion 65.02, tabled by Councillor Aref Salem, was consensual.
entries.cc97abe2bfa7438495a8fb5547ee72ec3e3f57fc: The Chair thanked Council members for their interventions and declared the new version of motion 65.02 unanimously adopted.
entries.03b090753ef73fb5c428d1a73d00b75ac773ec21: 1 - that the municipal council request the municipal administration to submit, as soon as possible, a plan for the deployment of photo radars in front of all primary and secondary schools in Montreal territory to prioritise, consistent with the orientations and objectives of the zero-vision 2025-2027 action plan aimed at securing the movements of the most vulnerable users;
entries.40e2dd773b84eb44525a0d875a7b2b356edcbcd9: 2 - that the revenue generated by findings of infringement, if any, continue to be reinvested in road safety initiatives, including safe accommodation near schools;
entries.5b6b8c4464b03aa87c0ef4d547de0777772e11c6: 3 - that the municipal council take advantage of the opportunity offered by the provincial election campaign to challenge provincial political parties and encourage them to publicly support the acceleration of the installation of photo radars in school areas, consistent with the objectives of road safety and child protection.
entries.d8f8960414c479d7192450e8fd43e15d88a0e232: The Deputy Leader of the Official Opposition, Christopher McCray, and Councillor Alan DeSousa tabled a new consensus version of point 65.03. The new version reads as follows:
entries.3978b86980121ec4b70b651cf250adb01e0875c9: Whereas road safety in the vicinity of primary schools is a major issue for Montreal families and all school stakeholders;
entries.3fc4c9dc6525b2fdc91165c2bc7de941384abde4: Whereas several parts of the city present recurring problems of excessive speed, endangering children, parents, school staff and residents;
entries.3bec4dba00825f675e621474c6612e828d89c778: Whereas the municipal administration is currently working on a plan for the deployment of mobile photo radars in school areas of the Montréal agglomeration with priority on speed-related road safety issues;
entries.10eb9a00f3695121a11b4995ea120ddd29a1fab1: Whereas data from the City of Montreal and various organizations, including Québec pedestrians, show that reducing vehicle speed significantly reduces the risk of collisions and the severity of injuries;
entries.255e572bb1f173eaa8855a0d81f46a765d004d03: Whereas automated speed control measures, such as photo radars, have demonstrated their effectiveness in several Canadian cities to reduce average vehicle speeds and improve pedestrian safety;
entries.624439b173fbda774c50e5e65edf24ba7c238711: Whereas the Projet Montréal party, during the 2025 municipal election campaign, proposed the installation of photo radars in front of each primary school in Montreal to protect children and enhance safety in school areas;
entries.aeb715dc420b26b55a4ce828f9bf5cd9bdf53a24: Whereas the purpose of this proposal was to provide a structural, timely and evidence-based measure to reduce dangerous behaviours and ensure a safe environment for school travel;
entries.dd0325aef41fb987698673b896c647276b40a779: Whereas, according to the data collected under the two pilot projects carried out by the Ministère des transports et de la mobility durable du Québec in recent years, the installation of photo radars reduces collisions in urban areas by 36.6% and reduces the average speed by 11 km/h;
entries.d2b766e2c5ca736b3d7f476d6550f3391eb6f382: Whereas the installation of photo radars is an effective tool, complementary to physical arrangements, for reducing speed and preventing collisions;
entries.e42b318f56ef393feb125e55eaa30210a76a30d2: Whereas child safety must remain a municipal priority, regardless of electoral cycles or changes in administration;
entries.453b5f35c1d302685df1d5779178408580431b0a: Whereas the City of Montreal has a zero vision strategy to eliminate deaths and serious injuries on its road network by 2040, and that the installation of photo radars in school areas is fully part of the measures recognized to achieve this objective;
entries.d1b839f9b699fff4f33edff68ae4dac938148bdc: Whereas the City of Montreal, in its submission on Bill 48, adopted in May 2024, reiterates that the current legislative framework limits the ability of municipalities to deploy automated control devices effectively and maintains that legislative amendments are necessary to allow for a wider, coherent and responsive deployment to urban road safety issues;
entries.38437aa8ec152da619f035547fc89d3999ce48c8: Whereas Bill 48 specifically aims to modernize the regime for automated detection and control systems, by providing municipalities with a more flexible and appropriate framework to combat speed and improve the safety of vulnerable users;
entries.20d034c61c9256389685bf1726e1602f5ed33dee: Whereas the current context of the provincial election campaign offers a relevant opportunity to raise awareness and encourage provincial political parties to take a position in favour of structural road safety measures, including the installation of photo radars in front of primary schools;
entries.d8c257c2614aceb896284f1a41539b01f4b1c12f: Whereas a clear provincial commitment to school road safety could support and accelerate the implementation of such measures in Montreal and elsewhere in Quebec;
entries.7d2a9dcc18f0bfaf65a3ecdb45381fa7fca0dac9: The Chair of Council, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to the proposer of the motion, the Deputy Leader of the Official Opposition, Christopher McCray, for his presentation and then to Councillor Céline-Audrey Beauregard and Councillor Alan DeSousa.
entries.cc7936e4bcd2da1e93549ee4849d8a6acafa0ecb: The Deputy Leader of the Official Opposition began his presentation by pointing out that, as the school year approached, road safety around schools remained a major concern for many parents. As the speed of vehicles around schools was often raised as a big issue, he felt that street planning would reduce the risk of accidents. He set out examples, among other things, where the effectiveness of photo radars to reduce speed and collisions had been demonstrated. McCray hoped that the government would deploy radar equipment quickly. Finally, Mr. McCray asked the City of Montreal to show leadership in calling for the priority installation of photo radars near all schools in the city and developing a development plan to better protect children and all road users.
entries.1bf6168e0fde5e2b5d56061343fc7bd72957b4c1: For her part, Councillor Céline-Audrey Beauregard stated that she supported the motion and stressed in particular the importance of ensuring safe travel for thousands of children going to school. She pointed out that speed was one of the most critical factors in the severity of collisions and emphasized that photo radars were not only tools for punitive measures but also prevention tools that promoted behavioural change. Ms. Beauregard concluded by inviting her colleagues to support the motion in order to improve safety in neighbourhoods and allow young people to go to school safely.
entries.9a784274cfa9c33d20d157cb532e536e989be06d: In turn, Councillor Alan DeSousa, the Administration's representative for this matter, said that he welcomed the motion with some modifications and pointed out that road safety around schools was a priority to protect the thousands of children travelling every day to their school. Mr. DeSousa stressed that excessive speed was a major factor in the severity of collisions and that photo radars had demonstrated their effectiveness in reducing speeds and saving lives. He would like to reinvest the revenues generated by violations in road safety. Finally, Councillor Alan DeSousa invited all parties, as they approached the provincial election campaign, to place child safety as an absolute priority.
entries.8d5684d731b313bf15bb07d78a6ef8c976b50f33: The Leader of the Official Opposition, Marie Plourde, confirms the consensus version of this motion.
entries.85bc1685d44438376d4753d37c2981ad5bf55854: The Chair thanked Council members for their interventions and declared the new version of motion 65.03 unanimously adopted.

entries.3b53f2d47d2da661b41106707ed21ff48d148584: 1. That the City Council reaffirm its commitment to preserve a territory where all resident persons can participate fully in public life without fear of hatred, intimidation, harassment or violence;
entries.ac13797541315d7e5f6707089b43773aae0db3ea: 2 - that the council of the agglomeration declares that the current rise of anti-Semitism is unacceptable and threatens the security of all residents of the island of Montreal, in particular those of the Jewish community of Montreal;
entries.8d3bfa1c97b38f6da586fddb9294f2d0ca651df1: 3 - that the council of the agglomeration condemn all forms of anti-Semitism, racism, religious hatred and identity-based intimidation and recognize that such acts harm not only their direct victims but also the entire social fabric of Montreal;
entries.854ea59c4549640fc0b82912eb993413651ed2c8: 4 - the City Council unequivocally reaffirms that any person resident on the Island of Montreal has the right to attend its school, higher education institution, place of work, place of worship, community institutions, businesses and public events without being intimidated, harassed, obstructed or abused;
entries.c4bec7d3f7551cdca2cccb96c048510050a9079b: 5 - that the conseil de l'agglomeration express its support for the City of Montreal Police Service and all public security partners in the consistent, impartial and non-selective application of the laws and by-laws in force, in accordance with the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms, the Charter of Human Rights and Freedoms of Quebec and the dignity and constitutional rights of each resident;
entries.1dfb7602f1bbcadd4d67e98fb8d145399a09036b: 6 - that the agglomeration of Montreal evaluate the measures necessary to ensure that all relevant public security personnel receive appropriate training to enable them to recognize, prevent and respond effectively to anti-Semitism;
entries.c4024ef1ffcc0e6866d0c0d560d4338c82a66af9: 7 - that the agglomeration of Montreal prioritise matters falling within its competence and on the concrete local consequences of their decisions by favouring public security, equal treatment, verifiable facts and peaceful coexistence, in the interest of social cohesion.
entries.f068dba1ff5356d4b72076ebe2aee8132c608c10: This is a motion tabled by David Tordjman, Mayor of the City of Côte Saint-Luc, to the Town Council pursuant to section 23 of the Town Council Internal Economy Regulations (RCG 06-027)
entries.7e7828112f460a1b39a47f858d12e842ab8b5c43: Whereas the agglomeration of Montreal, including the City of Montréal and the 15 independent cities reconstituted (hereinafter the agglomeration of Montreal), is based on the principles of democracy and the values of human dignity, justice, equality and peaceful intercultural coexistence;
entries.ad65cf74dae9d173e2f4847584d16e9ca64c406b: Whereas the agglomeration of Montreal exercises over its territory certain powers deemed to be of collective interest, which, rather than being exercised distinctly by the related municipalities, are
entries.46fe8cf4b04a3ac738ef1d17854b23441305fb02: exercised by the agglomeration, in particular, public safety jurisdiction including the City of Montreal Police Service;
entries.7ea38316ccde58673a99d28027435f2ecaa07ed0: Whereas the Montréal agglomeration has a fundamental responsibility to ensure public safety, to preserve social cohesion, to promote equal participation in civic life and to safeguard the dignity, security and freedoms of every person residing on the territory of the Montréal agglomeration;
entries.f26f04b2b74d1d9ead9ad73f60710df35fd81d7d: Whereas criticism by Governments and public policies is a legitimate and protected aspect of a democratic society; intimidation, discrimination, harassment, violence, collective guilt, dehumanization or direct or indirect targeting of persons on the basis of their religion, ethnicity, descent, national origin or supposed affiliations are fundamentally incompatible with the principles of equality, public security and social cohesion;
entries.6e2f4f3482e5d5cc565b70cda6430d8e7fc2eb2d: Whereas the agglomeration of Montreal is neither responsible for nor able to resolve international conflicts, and municipal institutions must remain focused on local issues within their jurisdiction and legal responsibilities;
entries.550adbdbfc82e4e97c12384eb1b9e517ae4eb8fc: Whereas, despite previous episodes of threats, intimidation, harassment, dehumanization, vandalism, hate crimes, violence and threats of violence, as well as exclusion, institutional discrimination and civic marginalization, targeting Jewish residents, Jewish schools, synagogues, Jewish community institutions and Jewish businesses;
entries.104e42ac4260d7456d7c35bfa342195a1d0ce5e6: Whereas these acts and episodes also included policies and practices preventing Jewish persons from holding certain positions, exercising their profession or accessing public spaces;
entries.55e8a7301c20e639aeaa65b304a801e4262204cd: Whereas these acts and episodes were based on discrimination on the grounds of ethnicity, religion, descent, national origin or supposed affiliations of Jewish persons, including anti-Semitism and all contemporary forms of anti-Semitism;
entries.604f3893d848676ea64325d007e58b929f68f0aa: Whereas, the Jewish community of Montreal has been an integral part of the agglomeration of Montreal for nearly three hundred years, with the Jewish presence in Montreal being uninterrupted since the 1760s despite the hardships stated, the Jewish community of Montreal has always contributed to Quebec society by founding hospitals, schools, libraries, social service networks, cultural institutions, community centres, philanthropic organizations and places of memory that have strengthened Quebec society and served people of all origins;
entries.9af8bfccb239cac62d227b0949225c07e5e6f5ce: Whereas the principles of diversity, equity, inclusion and anti-discrimination require that all communities be protected from racialization, collective guilt, discrimination based on identity, exclusion, intimidation and unfair treatment, and that many Montreal Jewish people have suffered such harm as a result of proven acts of anti-Semitism and minimization or rejection of their experiences, which is likely to undermine their sense of equality in terms of security, dignity, belonging and civic participation;
entries.e0868de301f1de70a83b178aa48c5f09c5b3d5ff: Whereas, since October 7, 2023, the date of the largest massacre of Jewish people since the Holocaust, the Montréal agglomeration has seen a documented increase in anti-Semitic incidents and that, according to the RCMP's latest data, Jewish people are the target of more than 70% of religiously motivated hate crimes in Canada, although they represent only one per cent or less of the population;
entries.ce52b8bcf9229cbcf3ccee72a7a1631037692954: Whereas, since October 7, 2023, the Jewish community on the Island of Montreal has suffered hundreds of anti-Semitic incidents (SPVM data showing 212 incidents between October 7, 2023 and the end of 2024), such as intimidation and vandalism in universities, cegeps, secondary schools and other institutions throughout the City, including:
entries.a1c1e886b0cce987e7272e5078784e81b1a3a0b5: - Shots fired at two Jewish schools in Montreal (November 2023);
entries.6549ffbcd474233145975894859103b3340199f4: An attempted incendiary attack on a synagogue in Côte Saint-Luc (October 2024);
entries.4e1ef1b2ddd485fecc0afec18af30674154d9d8b: The assault of a visible Jewish man at Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (August 2025);
entries.0a323cc44d9dd0319eb0c695e6021af053ae496e: Arson attempt at Emanu-El-Beth Sholom Temple in Westmount (June 2026);
entries.ada211b60405a4c3d4bf63a2b528cdf96c0b9a1e: The repeated harassment and intimidation of Montreal Jewish people, including the encircling of Jewish students in a student facility at Concordia University (March 2024);
entries.e2a75ca273096f9e442ca0380091d87e0f7332d4: The illegal camps at McGill University and the explosion of anti-Semitism on campus;
entries.27f9cdc8f31a12d3701e9b6b1fcdc7708dc5aac0: The blocking of participants in a Jewish event in the Côte-des-Neiges district at the headquarters of the CJA Federation (March 2024), followed by marches in front of the Spanish & Portuguese synagogue, which was founded in 1768 and is one of Montreal's oldest religious institutions (March 2024);
entries.cf4f8df72583b1dabbab11b36212145eab118307: 的 threats to Montreal Jewish people in St. Lawrence (August 2025);
entries.402efaa6f749cced29adfc5fa49a655171cba57a: - aggressive demonstrations in front of the Chevra Kadisha Synagogue in Côte-des-Neiges (May 2025);
entries.343dd7a29c77bf4b71db724da452be1d6dceefdf: The hanging of effigies representing Jewish people (May 2026);
entries.e32f0e9ac202b67f8418db0843cb794b3c2f552e: The harassment and theft of Orthodox Jewish men in Outremont and Mile End (July 2026);
entries.d616f34301d939d02de22d26e737d874e0ce585b: Whereas the Canadian Security Intelligence Service warns of persistent and ubiquitous foreign interference in Canada and that some evidence of such interference is now made public:
entries.1cb4fbb455dde0d72bd11f72f441fed30de381e2: (1) In a recent sentencing hearing before the Court of Quebec, the man who pleaded guilty to launching incendiary devices against a synagogue and community centre in Dollard-des-Ormeaux in 2024 stated that he had accepted a contract of $15,000 to target these Jewish institutions;
entries.3d7af47414cdb63825d5f4ad3ff47609eb0f4d3b: (2) in June 2026, the perpetrator of the attempted arson against a synagogue in Westmount had a walkie-talkie in his possession;
entries.3d292513be0a9f9c156dd28902f19b5dab2a841d: (3) shots fired at a synagogue and the U.S. Consulate in Toronto in 2026 appear to be linked to a network of "snipers";
entries.dc6184ab50d6cd6e3200b8eaf321aee601aeccdd: Whereas, since 7 October 2023, incidents including calls for violence, hate speech and symbols of acts or organizations designated as terrorists have taken place throughout the Montréal agglomeration, sometimes in close proximity to institutions of the Jewish community, raising concerns among the population about public safety and fair treatment of all communities;
entries.e58482a731c034542459fe81e32fb4bbbf3a27ed: Whereas violent and extremist discourses have been shown to lead to physical violence;
entries.e8246bcf358a859a9d3e7173e9a7c38101f7e8c1: Whereas the trivialization of hate rhetoric, the use of intimidation tactics, violent discourse, incitement to violence and the glorification or promotion of terrorism or political violence do not belong in the cities of Montréal and are fundamentally incompatible with the values of a democratic and peaceful society;
entries.5936be45dd5770b68ba191182174e2e398fa71c1: Whereas intimidation campaigns, targeting based on identity and the importation of foreign conflicts have the effect of dividing residents into ethnic, religious or national lines, weakening social cohesion and undermining the common civic identity on which democratic institutions in the Montréal metropolitan area depend;
entries.e9b0e603fd242cb529037f4dd51cadd8ef0702dc: Whereas the elected representatives of the Montréal agglomeration have the responsibility to ensure that any declaration or municipal resolution is based on facts and respects all the communities concerned in order to ensure that social cohesion and relations between the communities of the Montréal agglomeration are maintained;
entries.5c4c5699e8568df0c3d36c7990ff8ff83e005394: Having informed the municipal council of the title subject to be discussed at the meeting of the town council on 27 August 2026 and having set out the position to be taken;
entries.25b30486adb44df5989e6a8e2618b488f2b70366: The Chair of the Council, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to the Mayor of Montreal, Soraya Martinez Ferrada, and then to Councillor Olivier Demers-Dubé.
entries.77c4ffdb8356d48ec37e1c8d54539f7b8ce44c52: In particular, the Mayor of Montreal pointed out that cultural diversity was one of Montréal's main assets and expressed concern at the rise of anti-Semitism in the metropolis. She also stressed that the motion aimed to denounce this situation and reiterated that any form of hatred or discrimination based on identity remained unacceptable and, in that sense, supported the motion.
entries.5b602cd8dff1e82d4893527ad679c27eae121940: At the outset, Mr. Demers-Dubé acknowledged the fairness and relevance of the majority of the proposals put forward in this motion, as well as the seriousness of the anti-Semitic acts mentioned, and reiterated that anti-Semitism and any form of discrimination were unacceptable, but expressed reservations about certain provisions of the motion, believing that they might limit the Council's ability to debate freely. Finally, he believed that the fight against anti-Semitism should be based on measures that reinforced democratic principles and not restricted them.
