entries.faa75eb5d58d26dfdd62208400e20cc7f36b79aa: 1 - the City Council will interpret the Act to promote living together and to regulate accommodation for religious reasons in such a way as to reflect the culture, diversity and distinctiveness of Montreal, in accordance with the criteria set out in sections 2 and 3 of that Act;
entries.7cf5500719e4c54cd09efb79448f91dafc6d0ae4: 2. that boroughs be designated as competent authorities to analyse and authorize religious events in their territory, because of their proximity to communities and their ability to assess local issues;
entries.19367098c257b99d56860b7e962f1c57ce5b1bec: 3 - that Montreal's diversity be recognized as a guiding principle in the analysis of applications and considered an essential element of the Montréal social fabric;
entries.2a5f9caa712ced59738dbf194e0172d5678326ee: 4 - that the City Council reaffirm its commitment to an inclusive, pluralistic and respectful Montreal with respect for the rights and freedoms of all persons, and commit itself to applying the Act promoting living together and guiding accommodation on religious grounds in a spirit of respect, fairness and solidarity towards citizens;
entries.d9d4a6223f8ea6cf988b516243b29b8127853f0b: 5 - that the municipal council reaffirm its commitment to remain firm and united in defending life together and ensuring that all communities can evolve in a climate of peace, security and dignity;
entries.0ed3729c44d9c420efb6b3cdd2dfa33958c12a35: 6 - the municipal council reiterates its collective responsibility to ensure that every person, regardless of his or her origin or beliefs, can feel safe and respected;
entries.fa516ef54e56d7e2b9f321eaeda93e37fd95a783: 7 - that Montreal belongs to all its residents and residents.
entries.0d19622d3f9e930490af027a6db3ccc1af32511b: Whereas the Act promoting living together and providing for accommodation on religious grounds, adopted by the National Assembly in April 2026, governs the authorization of religious events and provides, inter alia, in article 2, that no public highway or public park may be used for purposes of collective religious practice, unless a municipality authorizes, exceptionally and on a case-by-case basis, such use in its public domain;
entries.331d3d898d7c935d79ef6bd07f3877768b4163c4: Whereas Article 3 of the Act specifies that a municipality may grant an authorisation that if use "does not compromise the safety of persons, is short-lived, is accessible to all and does not unduly impede access to the public domain";
entries.efc119cf4a1ef525e34e20d968e14d39b964b34d: Whereas Montreal is a plural urban environment, marked by cultural diversity that shapes its identity and contributes to its social vitality;
entries.b983e6ccdc54aa0ba8390cfccdc0fe83e2474d05: Whereas the boroughs of Montreal have an in-depth knowledge of their local communities and are best placed to assess requests for events according to the realities of their territory;
entries.ae0973efce1dd24dc561feb5b1203f2bc92f6dc9: Whereas the unique character of Montreal is based on a model of living together based on respect, inclusion, collaboration and recognition of different cultural and religious expressions;
entries.cfe4a2f7e62756ce0ba5fe52670f566fdd7b2066: Whereas several religious events have a historical, heritage, cultural or community dimension;
entries.fa51764b5ace7be233ba0dd7f6a7eab35323d8a1: Whereas the municipal council wishes to ensure that the Act promotes living together and provides accommodation for a religious reason in accordance with its fundamental values, its commitment to social cohesion and the protection of living together;
entries.f77dcc68754f42644104d74ff56ae524fc2943d8: The Mayor of Montreal recalls first of all that the recent adoption of the Act promoting living together and regulating accommodation for a religious reason imposes on municipalities a new framework of application, particularly with regard to collective religious practices in public space. Then she specifies that the City of Montreal intends to apply this law rigorously, while taking into account local realities and favouring an interpretation marked by sensitivity, intelligence and humanity.
entries.b3b7b426c8c545ac60a8ae815153ccc43d54bb86: In addition, it highlights the plural and diverse nature of the metropolis, stressing that this diversity constitutes a wealth to be valued rather than an issue to be contained. It also underlines the central role of boroughs in analysing and authorizing events, because of their proximity to communities and their knowledge of the terrain.
entries.9e5db2a71d8b5d23eb3ee706904f9ae19a4663e5: Finally, Ms. Martinez Ferrada reaffirmed the importance of living together as a fundamental value and called on members to adopt the declaration in order to ensure an inclusive and harmonious application of the law, while ensuring that a climate of peace, security and dignity was preserved for all communities.
entries.edfe11bde8421eb722b670ad0e954efcf16236b0: The President of the Council gave the floor to the Leader of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus.
entries.c0ca11fcf8a885e6885bc95269aa3b04f64902c2: At the outset, Ms. Alneus indicated that she joined with the Mayor of Montreal, while recalling that the City must ensure a nuanced application of the law in order to guarantee every person the freedom to live his faith or lack of faith, in dignity and respect. In addition, she maintained that Montreal's diversity was a wealth to be preserved, consistent with the values of concord and living together. In closing, she wished for an application of the law respecting Montréal's uniqueness.
entries.e876b8d3120c68c206d3e4c796313e2f72b76230: The Chair of the Board, Chantal Rossi, thanked the Mayor of Montreal and the Chief of the Official Opposition for their interventions.
entries.9bc1f95be8765b1f3b800aa9a3ae420508c72184: 1 - that the City of Montreal reaffirm its determination, in collaboration with indigenous nations and communities, to combat racism and systemic discrimination faced by Aboriginal Montrealers while promoting their social, economic and cultural development;
entries.9c693ca7213af21bd3472154fdb706ebdc3bd587: 2 - that the City of Montreal continue its commitment to reconciliation with Aboriginal peoples through public policies and municipal action plans, economic development, urban planning and housing projects, as well as social and cultural investments;
entries.e09f60699b3ea5a0962e77144bab288b3aa043b3: 3 - that the City of Montreal be firmly committed, with its Aboriginal community partners and the health and social services network and other levels of government, to putting in place more appropriate and safe resources for Aboriginal people who are more vulnerable or homeless;
entries.def59e145d05d4dd84c1c7db32bf5b0de75a0a60: 4 - that the City Council invites Montrealers to join Aboriginal communities in celebrating the richness of their cultures by taking part in numerous activities organized as part of the National and Montreal Indigenous Peoples' Day.
entries.3a14c81a6a9aec72114a7a5a7dd12805ca628854: Whereas the celebration of National Aboriginal History Month in June and National and Montreal Indigenous Peoples' Day on June 21 is intended to promote recognition of the history, cultures, traditions and contributions of Aboriginal people in Montreal;
entries.1a26052992f9f8f2699381354187cf3a31fb0be3: Whereas these celebrations provide a unique opportunity to learn more about the richness of First Nations, Inuit and Métis cultural heritage and history;
entries.0337e7ecd11db52dfae03f35c0a143e23e69e584: Whereas, on 13 September 2007, the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples was adopted by the General Assembly of the United Nations and unanimously endorsed by the City of Montreal on 21 August 2017, in a movement towards reconciliation inviting recognition and respect for the rights of Canadian indigenous peoples;
entries.0a624589ada7e079a0de5954d84163aed8becf34: Whereas the various Aboriginal nations and communities contribute to the development and outreach of the City of Montreal in all spheres of society;
entries.dac2c2a0372d58687dd9e5338a3e1fc2497894e2: Whereas many actions of the Montreal municipal administration are part of a process of reconciliation with Aboriginal peoples, aimed at creating lasting relationships, including the creation of a position of Commissioner for Relations with Indigenous Peoples currently occupied by Randy Legault-Rankin, the integration of white pine into the town's coat of arms and flag and the translation of the Montreal Charter of Rights and Responsibilities into Kanien'kéha;
entries.e736d5619a571010784793447220f166549ebdb3: Whereas the reconciliation process places at the heart of its priorities the development and respect for indigenous history, languages, knowledge, traditions and cultures;
entries.6e7e10a36242ba69fa175a2b8ddcc217519ecc48: Whereas the City of Montreal's first ever Reconciliation Strategy with Indigenous Peoples 2020-2025 is the result of several years of cooperation and recognizes the island's millennial Aboriginal history as well as its contribution to the cultural fabric of the city;
entries.2327cebc07edf3c3eb8ff8189429be2af52db3ed: Whereas this strategy is intended to strengthen the Authority's relationship with Aboriginal peoples and to open up the City in the fight against racism, systemic discrimination and injustices faced by First Nations, Inuit and Métis people;
entries.983e3085596cffeefa4ee61f17fc1fcf799974f2: Whereas in 2021, following the recommendation of the report of the Office de consultation publique de Montréal (OCPM) on systemic racism and discrimination, the City of Montreal amended the Montreal Charter of Rights and Responsibilities to add the endorsement of the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples to its preamble.
entries.a4afab9feeb61409609db5238b898430e6e9f0d9: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Josué Corvil for the presentation of the Declaration.
entries.e46f69824858566f22bc8b40bac4d1fd653c5d1e: First, Councillor Josué Corvil acknowledges that Montreal is located on a thousand-year indigenous territory, a place of meeting and diplomacy, particularly marked by the Treaty of Great Peace. He thanks the Kanien-kehà:ka nation for its hospitality in this unceded territory.
entries.4f3fc2ffa873351a1be8fd65d096d2378bcf5bbf: It marks National Aboriginal People's Day, celebrated on June 21, as well as National Aboriginal History Month, and invites people to deepen their knowledge of First Peoples, Inuit and Métis cultures. It recalls that reconciliation is achieved through, among other things, structuring actions and partnerships with Aboriginal communities, both in decision-making processes and collaborative practices. In this regard, it promotes rich and diverse programming reflecting the multiple realities and expressions of Aboriginal cultures.
entries.1cf7b1f9fea8b7be26f453c9d602bc5076238a63: Lastly, he reiterated the Administration's commitment to strengthening sustainable relations, continuing dialogue and supporting initiatives, while inviting people to participate in the proposed activities.
entries.2f389d8e64474ff2d76ff52abe30481ab1b0c24f: The Chair gave the floor to Councillors Émilie Brière and Andréanne Moreau, respectively.
entries.20bc66ecfdba3d6e0f638f007359e4613417b247: Ms. Brière mentioned that, although the City highlighted the contribution of many communities to Montréal's cultural life, the declaration surrounding Aboriginal History Month was distinguished by its special significance and recalled the importance of celebrating the cultures, languages, traditions and knowledge of the peoples in the territory where we settled.
entries.528db1b0f01499fe206a4a705db619737111e01c: She also noted that the sustainability of these cultures remains fragile; some languages have disappeared, and many cultural expressions would benefit from being more valued and shared; in this context, Ms. Briere believes that celebrating Aboriginal History Month is a moral duty and an essential basis for appreciating Montréal's cultural diversity.
entries.faa3ffdf3a5140372c190627c448dccc61305a52: She concludes by thanking the guests present today.
entries.3d227db74c301c4b8585c9a3fb1215f46e32dc5b: From the outset, Ms. Moreau shares a significant experience associated with her participation in a first-word ceremony, guided by a knowledge keeper, where she discovered an approach to the world that focused on recognizing what was owed to the elements, gratitude and listening to others.
entries.8d1f64576e95a787c72e665a35d5fa85457eeeff: It highlights the importance of gathering together, re-focusing in community and taking care of the bonds that unite individuals, in a spirit of balance and respect.
entries.84a5a10d9a6b65cf96ad37aef4148285d99313df: Marked by this experience, Ms. Moreau concludes by inviting Montrealers to discover this way of being, which requires time, attention and openness to other perspectives.
entries.397ed89296a7ec93eef9ee9085d40b849e9d590f: The Chair thanked those elected for their interventions.
entries.42bafff932d42381230aa6ced6c740bae41eaec8: 1 - that the City of Montreal officially recognize Italian Heritage Month in the metropolis;
entries.73138f9249aea01aacaad53cb67046e28b97ad7e: 2 - that the City emphasises the exceptional contributions of the Italian community to the development of Montreal, and reaffirms its commitment to promote, protect and spread the Italian heritage for future generations;
entries.761b18d632f63b9e14aef177a8ed5ead33069cd2: 3 - that the City of Montreal invites all Montrealers to participate in the festivities surrounding Italian Heritage Month and take advantage of the various programs to learn more about the richness of Italian culture.
entries.e2b58398d30f5fec1bc24aab347d6cdd9a03eddb: Whereas more than 135,000 Montrealers reported being of Italian origin during the Statistics Canada census in 2021, representing almost 8% of the Montréal population and 43% of Quebecers of Italian origin;
entries.533cbf07457514c577c5fb6106f302163b80c5bc: Whereas 2 June marks the national holiday of the Italian Republic, and celebrations take shape in diasporas all over the world;
entries.5e69a21fbdc6a88cadaad58a1512638ae2a53136: Whereas in May 2017, the House of Commons unanimously adopted a motion recognizing the contributions of Italian Canadians to society and the richness of their culture and language, now designating June as Italian Heritage Month;
entries.03894d02d80bbe6124e265553021bb3f7c906f07: Whereas the Italian community has actively contributed to the construction of the metropolis, by participating greatly in its socio-economic, cultural, artistic and heritage development;
entries.1d455af3cdc975d6e5aef0ecb81aa7abe33e1408: Whereas June 10 is recognized as the Day of Commemoration of the Internment of 591 Italian-Canadians in 1940 by the Canadian Government and that this day was officially recognized by the City Council of Montreal in March 2013;
entries.8a78c1d981deb9b3e94f665d0a591238a53403b4: Whereas, on May 27, 2021, the federal government offered its official apology to the Italian-Canadian communities for their treatment during the Second World War;
entries.1f517ac953097d359f7c3d91e3e725ec3c98f506: Whereas, through their hard work and determination, immigrants from Italy have helped to transform neighbourhoods into prosperous communities, creating spaces where culture and traditions have been preserved and celebrated;
entries.bc3625a537011084a84da955b0678ffbf3700e4b: Whereas the area between Saint-Zotique and Jean-Talon streets, known as "Little Italy", is an emblematic cultural centre for both the Italian community and all Montrealers, and it houses historical institutions such as Madonna della Difesa Church, inaugurated in 1919, one of the country's most remarkable Italian-Canadian works of art, entirely hand painted by Guido Nincheri;
entries.018c102fd79d18a09a0bedb06f0eda9da1f60752: Whereas Casa d'Italia, which celebrates its 90th anniversary in 2026, is the most emblematic historical and cultural site of the Italian community in Montreal, a lasting symbol of its history, its immense contribution to the city and its exceptional cultural heritage;
entries.409a0ccaef1987a04e2261f7d01946996d770304: Whereas the Canadian-Italian Community Foundation of Quebec, established 50 years ago in Saint-Léonard, is a major philanthropic organization that supports charitable, educational, cultural and social initiatives throughout the province, and over time has provided more than $27 million to some 170 organizations and projects;
entries.7a714564268c54f9b50d902fd875c07dfcea6609: Whereas the Leonardo da Vinci Centre, located in Saint-Léonard, is a flagship institution of the Italian-Canadian community in Quebec dedicated to the promotion of Italian culture and heritage, a symbol of pride, including the 533-seat Mirella & Lino Saputo Theatre;
entries.f25e1c0729df638e5b4cec55799868f4c966eafd: Whereas the Congress of Italian-Canadians of the Quebec Region is the organization that plays a central role in promoting the cultural identity and civic commitment of this community;
entries.0b7fbeca53ae41ce88fab8af6e02d24924d91846: Whereas CRAIC is an organization that highlights programs and initiatives that promote social ties, helps seniors maintain friendship and remain active in community life while reducing loneliness, and that the Canadian-Italian Community Services of Quebec support vulnerable people;
entries.468ec20271fa1926910b95591ae46768f077f9ca: Whereas the Italian-Canadian Business and Professional Association (CIBPA Montréal), founded in 1949, which represents Italian-Canadian business and professional leaders in Quebec, is a highly committed organization in youth networking, mentoring and leadership development;
entries.3d2d009d2250f071b326e93fea1cda368d55a254: Whereas, on 13 May 2005, the CRTC authorized the arrival in Canada of foreign televisions, including Rai-Italia, allowing many cultural communities to access the channels of their country of origin and enrich Canada's cultural heritage;
entries.ba84f45c59128e3edefacf75c61fcc402c6a5538: Whereas generations of Italian-Canadian people have contributed to many areas while preserving their cultural heritage, and this contribution has played a major role in the multicultural identity of Montreal, demonstrating that diversity strengthens, energizes and increases society;
entries.5dde30eee739de93db25ceced1c817366bfc4fe2: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Dominic Perri for the presentation of the Declaration.
entries.30eaf76a40c60596ad30e2c319e0654004add00c: Mr. Perri outlined some aspects of his journey, stating that he was the first district mayor who came from the Italian community, thus highlighting the contribution of this community to the democratic life and development of the city. He then proceeded to the official reading of the Declaration, noting the salient elements of it and their scope.
entries.83f92fee123c6e5f0d72e4fdb8451190bf6e6131: He concluded his speech by presenting and welcoming the guests present on the balcony, thanking them for their contribution.
entries.9ea5a81b49a781d7bac6b05ff3401ccc7769c7eb: The Chair gave the floor respectively to Councillor Laura Palestini, Councillors Victor Esposito and Giovanni Rapanà, Councillor Élise Tanguay and Councillor Jocelyn Pauzé.
entries.69926eba9130ad84adf637fc6d0e357b75b9b1ce: Last June 2nd marked the 80th anniversary of the Festa della Repubblica, which commemorates the abolition of the monarchy in Italy and the establishment of the Republic. On this occasion, Mrs. Palestini puts forward her Italian roots. She also mentions the journey of her grandparents, who have immigrated to Canada and contributed to the transmission of their culture. She also underlines the significant contribution of the Italian community to the social, cultural and economic development of the City. In closing, she offers, on behalf of the council of LaSalle and on her personal behalf, her condolences to the family of little Ava, tragically deceased.
entries.c66b47b2db52bf39229032deb1f727c0704ffac3: Councillor Victor Esposito spoke for the first time and stressed the significance of this intervention within the framework of Italian Heritage Month. He indicated that he was the son of Italian parents who had chosen Montreal as their home land and briefly referred to his journey and his connection with Italian language and culture. He believed in the importance of transmitting family values, respect and work, while recalling certain episodes of history, including the internment and supervision of Italo-Canadians, thus reiterating the duty of memory. He concluded by recalling that Italian Heritage Month was an opportunity to pay tribute to generations who had helped build the city.
entries.325f8a2efcea85df21a5899b02da97e2e6c14345: In his speech, Councillor Giovanni Rapanà tells us in particular "that from the last century on, thousands of Italians and Italians chose our city to build their future. They arrived with their dreams, their courage and a remarkable will to contribute to the society that welcomed them. They have built companies, participated in the construction of our neighbourhoods, enriched our institutions, animated our cultural life and transmitted to their children values of work, solidarity and perseverance that continue to shape our metropolis. Their contribution goes far beyond the borders of their respective communities. It is now an integral part of Montreal's identity.
entries.89cf5051570f75ef2b3e9a3cc4cf8f8773641a7f: When we speak of Montreal as a city open to the world, proud of its diversity and strong of its multiple cultures, we also talk about the contribution of the Italian community. A community that has helped make our metropolis what it is today: a more dynamic, prosperous and humane city."
entries.dc376a7abf98475272c6a32dc2f7de102d1229ee: The Councillor Élise Tanguay continues with the historic anchoring of the Italian community in the neighbourhoods of Ville-Émard and Côte-Saint-Paul, particularly around the industrial activities on Rue Saint-Patrick and Boulevard Monk. She also evokes the political commitment of these communities, marked by the creation of places of discussion such as the Sala Mazzini on Rue Jolicœur and the organization of antifascist activities, in a context where these actions were sometimes perceived as subversive. She concludes by expressing her gratitude to local organizations, including the age d ́or de Saint-Jean-de-Bosco and the Association des familles calabrians, which still participate today in the community vitality of Ville-Émard and Côte-Saint-Paul.
entries.e6625da9df484d37c9db8680d51a3b882d48fd74: Finally, Councillor Jocelyn Pauzé highlights the decisive contribution of the Italian community to Montreal's identity, particularly in Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie. He praises a culture that is expressed through arts, music, film and the values of generosity and living together, contributing in a sustainable way to the collective wealth of the city.
entries.07535df84e3d84a850978d69f66558fcc26f0c46: In this spirit, it refers to the importance of gathering events such as ItalfestMTL (formerly Italian Week of Montreal), which celebrates its 32nd anniversary and proposes a varied program promoting exchanges between cultures. It invites the population to participate in the activities of Little Italy, recognizing the essential contribution of artists and members of the community, true guardians of an inheritance that continues to enrich Montreal.
entries.a86316479dbbf1c4b4b5199cb62d348d61eac873: The Chair thanked the six elected representatives for their interventions.
entries.37382c50f45bb2e4545b73940acd164dc5b62309: 1 - that the City of Montreal recognize compas music as a form of rich cultural and musical art of great importance to its Haitian diaspora and to the general population;
entries.bf1918d928e0a25a7a7e39b16756c85e9a041994: 2 - the City of Montreal emphasizes the importance of compass in the city's musical history;
entries.1d562396aee726ed145b73330bf77dfc77552105: 3 - that the City of Montreal encourage the celebration and promotion of compas music within the metropolis, recognizing its role in strengthening cultural ties and artistic diversity.
entries.1ef140e0c1a502ec95f50b4065199b3a53e0a3da: Whereas compas music, also known as Konpa Dirèk, is a vibrant and influential musical genre, originating in Haiti, which has profoundly influenced Caribbean and global music;
entries.6dece06c7c818882711dd1e118565321c358bf2a: Whereas the compas was created and popularized in the mid-1950s by the legendary Haitian saxophonist and guitarist Nemours Jean-Baptiste, whose artistic vision has merged several musical influences to give birth to a unique energizing sound;
entries.ed4ff444901c0a95e1e8476702ebced7985cdeef: Whereas, on 10 December 2025, UNESCO officially included compas music in the intangible cultural heritage of humanity;
entries.7c4117a094935d65fdc0be0c0f0ae7dc9415319e: Whereas compass music is an expression of identity as well as a vector of joy, resilience and pride for the Haitian people;
entries.2573cc96f967a0fb2060b40e034920228bc8ea50: Whereas Montreal welcomes an important Haitian community that has contributed and continues to contribute to the development of the metropolis in all its spheres of activity, both urbanism, arts, gastronomy, culture and music;
entries.fa84c4eb1f6adb104ef6e11f0e65b21dc862e2d2: Whereas compas music is an integral part of Montreal's musical sphere, in particular as part of the programming of the Festival International de Jazz, Festival Nuits d'Afrique, Festival International Mizik Kréyol de Montréal, Festival Haiti en Folie and Festival Caribo Latino;
entries.8027e54d909a7575cd5a57886eab11b4286eb014: Whereas the greatest names of compas music occur on Montreal scenes as part of emblematic events in the metropolis;
entries.e1cbddb9ce6c1023bb02344665ecb2a01de1d81f: Whereas Joseph Dieudonné Larose, one of the most prolific artists in compas music, signed the Montreal Golden Book in 2024;
entries.bd7785781acf37df7952d3966e698fbf5276f4f4: Whereas the Cities of New York, Boston, Paris, North Miami, Miami, Miramar, Opa-Loca, West Palm Beach, Orlando have proposed official municipal statements on compas music;
entries.5ebb8fdb16f9df12bc6d5cd0f2c33e19e0b58d45: From the outset, Councillor Josué Corvil states that cultural communities occupy an important place in Montréal's cultural life, thanks in particular to the musical richness they bring there. He indicates that compas music, carried by the Haitian diaspora, finds a fertile and dynamic ground there. According to him, compas music in Montreal is distinguished by an active scene where tradition and modernity meet, through groups and numerous events from the Haitian community. Councillor Corvil defines this genre of music, both festive and bearer of identity, as a symbol of resilience and Haitian cultural heritage.
entries.5352dc7ee902d1f3f2377ccf2484cf02d94462cb: Subsequently, Mr. Corvil recounts that the compass, created in the 1950s by Nemours Jean-Baptiste in Haiti, has evolved over time by integrating various influences and gaining international recognition. He demonstrates, among other things, that the metropolis now houses about twenty active groups and hosts festivals, shows that value this music. He appoints emblematic and contemporary artists contributing to making the public vibrate while perpetuating tradition. Finally, Councillor Josué Corvil concludes by welcoming guests to the balcony and believes that the compass remains a source of pride, hope and gathering, embodying the vitality and continuity of Haitian culture in Montreal.
entries.55f5981930e9844c55c886eebcc2adfe9c0697a0: The Chair thanked him and subsequently gave the floor to Councillor Carla Beauvais and the Leader of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus.
entries.c2de4d58586bb8e54f10ccbb2c6e2420795592a9: In her turn, Councillor Carla Beauvais honours the memory of the singer Dieudonné Larose, known for her contribution to Haitian music. She salutes the family of the latter present on the balcony as well as representatives of compas music in Montreal. Finally, Ms. Beauvais says she is happy to bring her voice to this Declaration and the importance it will have in Montreal society.
entries.b0d12cc9b5f9424c9c9dc829beaf1ecf7dce49f5: In summary, the head of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus, thanked the guests present and stressed in particular the importance of the compass in her life, transmitted by her father from an early age. She concluded by indicating that the compass had helped to forge her identity and her deep attachment to Haitian culture and thus declared "kite konpa mache".
entries.5b45dedcd3e4c38ebb224e4975a7b6e9dc0fadb2: The Chair of the Board, Chantal Rossi, thanked them for their interventions and added the name of Councillor Sonny Moroz as a backer to the Statement.

entries.2cc26f2556e0ebdb2b18151f1f76c504b90a06b5: 2 - that the City Council mandate the Housing Service to conduct a thorough analysis of the implementation of a tax on vacant or underutilized housing in the territory of the City of Montreal, pursuant to the powers granted by An Act to amend the Municipal Taxation Act and other legislative provisions adopted in December 2023;
entries.c401a604b7620319bf8886d599989551bf0a6e4c: 3 - that the analysis of this application includes the parameters of application provided for by law, in particular the criteria of vacation, which include unoccupation of 180 days or more, the categories of exemptions and the rates applicable according to the property value of the buildings;
entries.48dba6f0055abc28609120dc78b927eee09420d1: 4 - take into account best practices elsewhere, particularly in large Canadian cities that have implemented similar measures, as well as the federal tax on under-used housing;
entries.794e6534c78aed08ed92290bf9604f906a9e5e89: 5 - the municipal council reaffirms that the primary objective of such a tax is to encourage the rapid return of housing to the rental market, in order to increase the available supply and help limit rent increases;
entries.7e199006529889bb449ecf042a3fb614cbc669c6: 6 - that the income generated by this tax may, where appropriate, be allocated to housing initiatives, including support for affordable housing or vulnerable households;
entries.f0a005a7741716ae45cc65615acb45e71a8bc217: 7 - that the municipal government report to the municipal council as soon as possible on the analysis of implementation options, including operational issues identified by other municipalities and solutions to address them.
entries.18f667f68b7d7bb815262801422facc3adbb860e: Counsel Elvira Carhuallanqui and Caroline Braun tabled a new consensus version of 65.01. The new version reads as follows:
entries.5ce2e768e2e5c96971a9aba775f853142151f866: Whereas the housing crisis in Montreal and Quebec results in an increased scarcity of available housing and a sustained increase in rents;
entries.d6ebd52fa6136121d65a68a3232224d751a707bc: Whereas the rapid increase in the supply of available rental housing is an essential lever for stabilizing and exerting downward pressure on rents;
entries.ed5979c24358a470cbf0d77bb0aa637a75b93593: Whereas part of the residential housing stock remains vacant or underutilized, in particular due to speculative practices, short-term rental use or intermittently occupied residences;
entries.619ccddc70b24f0d9c3f8f4e903587aefaf28bce: Whereas on November 2, 2023, the Government of Quebec introduced Bill No. 39 amending municipal taxation, which was passed on December 8, 2023 and sanctioned on the same day;
entries.811c6af61ca07de4949d0ea1d73d7855fb931ee6: Whereas this Act grants municipalities the power to impose a tax on vacant or underused housing, in particular when housing is unoccupied for at least 180 days per year;
entries.137f00276ae1a36073a5440c7286f44e8fa19dc2: Whereas this tax may be established on the basis of the property value of the dwelling and up to 3 % of it according to the terms chosen by the municipality;
entries.614b93739b6441b1ab7dfd96614e7e81e099d5e8: Whereas the purpose of this tax tool is explicitly to encourage homeowners to occupy or rent their homes, thus contributing to a rapid increase in available rental supply, particularly in a context of scarcity;
entries.5de42d87c674bd20ca70d5977da270f83e8e92a7: Whereas comparable experiences elsewhere in Canada demonstrate the effectiveness of this type of measure, including a significant reduction in vacant housing in several major cities, including Toronto, Vancouver, and Ottawa;
entries.63a4b30b166caf8acf95dfcfa2c9122d12cb49f5: Whereas the federal government has also introduced a tax on underutilized housing, which came into effect on 1 January 2022, in order to combat the underutilization of residential housing stock;
entries.2d3283bac6be4e48334819a2a459f800581ef4e3: Whereas the main purpose of this new tax is not to increase municipal revenues, but rather to change the behaviour of owners in order to bring residential units back into the rental market;
entries.fd38f876856fcd2cbf5eed5866df4b98a47138ff: Whereas this tool is a relevant lever for transforming vacant housing into housing and rapidly increasing supply in the existing stock;
entries.896a1836ebf64f81e0e74433aedb421996f57008: Whereas, in the context of the housing crisis, the mobilization of existing housing stock is one of the fastest and most effective ways to meet housing needs;
entries.31ba5ea4671b73897aa4a08a91cc99b713800042: Council Chair Chantal Rossi gave the floor to the motion, Councillor Elvira Carhuallanqui.
entries.02dbabd8b73a0c2ba26c889bf0dff4944d572452: Ms Carhuallan, who first presented the ultimate objective of this motion, which was to quickly put housing back into the rental market in order to increase the available supply by introducing a tax on vacant housing, believed that it would limit rent price increases and become an important tool for preventing homelessness. Finally, she believed in a pragmatic approach by following the criteria of Law 39 and in parallel, collecting evidence on the situation.
entries.df7bdf09325e922c899a6113a78feb3e7fa50b96: The Chair then gave the floor to the Authority's representative, Caroline Braun, and Elise Tanguay, respectively.
entries.ac94e65565fa0c49e6fc267b170bfda37c3dac91: Ms. Braun began by emphasizing the agreement with the Official Opposition and the need to be ambitious, creative and agile in order to deal with this housing crisis, including the few amendments made to this motion such as market analysis and data analysis, and concluded by quoting the mandate given to the Housing Service for that purpose.
entries.e4eefe96cc0032935ef07677abd1b377a790ca76: Counsel Elise Tanguay confirmed that she would not oppose the changes put forward by the Administration in this consensual version of the motion, adding, among other things, that the power given by the provincial government to act should help deter owners from maintaining vacant housing, with a view to increasing the supply of rental housing in the near future.
entries.c22e8e13a61f1ce3c319ca51562ebc9d982ba893: In closing, Councillor Elvira Carhuallan, who exercises her right of reply.

entries.9de4c7fe12646ea481dbc01bca6cf9a1c08cc332: 1 - is proud to highlight and support the 24th edition of the International Day against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia on 17 May 2026, worn by the Emergence Foundation;
entries.099baf77481ea207918f9de50e76d9a74627842b: 2 - recalls the importance of Allies, the campaign theme of the Emergence Foundation, for the inclusion of people of sexual and gender diversity in all life environments;
entries.9892ac3220f63e624a9ee1aff061c85e9e249ef7: 3 - in line with its LGBTQ2+ municipal commitments, actively combat all forms of homophobic, transphobic, lesbian and biphobic discrimination and violence in public spaces and support community-based prevention initiatives;
entries.10bf26b1e3828b30bc0e77ac1f9b0c31457c8d87: 4 - builds on best practices in municipal policies and commitments within the Rainbow Cities Network international network;
entries.59e7b2f6b17022848daf54333748fc1b2d146049: 5 - invites Montrealers and Montrealers to actively combat all forms of discrimination against LGBTQ2+ people, and to celebrate the immense wealth brought by people from sexual and gender diversity in the metropolis.
entries.c8759e71d57159dc415393b1146d7b7bff4d2cea: Whereas 17 May is the date on which the World Health Organization withdrew homosexuality from the list of mental illnesses in 1990;
entries.5325c7d9de6ad0c256c73c8e1198750b97a18927: Whereas in 2003, at the initiative of its founder, Laurent McCutcheon, the Emergence Foundation launched the very first National Day against Homophobia, which became the International Day against Homophobia and Transphobia in 2014, which is now international and highlighted on 17 May in dozens of countries;
entries.2997dfa9b74b2afb6d0c1a71e2be70cb270200e5: Whereas the City of Montreal is firmly committed to combating all forms of discrimination, including discrimination based on sex and sexual orientation, as part of the adoption of its Montreal Charter of Rights and Responsibilities in 2005;
entries.961c28597a89f71f12662cb11bdc2a182f080fe1: Whereas the City of Montreal hosted the major International Conference on LGBT Human Rights during the 2006 Outgames, following which the Montreal Declaration was adopted, a major text that inspired the defence of rights in Quebec, Canada and internationally;
entries.5c58bec1fb724e80c63c841109d908cfed08298b: Whereas the City of Montreal officially adopted this Declaration in 2007;
entries.f4788cf26b0b43887ff9f269a0229038f4fcb0ef: Whereas the City of Montreal was the first North American city in May 2022 to join and participate actively in the Rainbow Cities Network, which protects the rights of LGBTQ2+ people by bringing together members of civil society, municipal governments, political decision-makers as well as experts and experts to develop innovative and inclusive public policies;
entries.a975e72ef305ba7622e8ec21074a020920c1e9bf: Whereas it was in March 2025 that the City of Montreal adopted the very first Declaration to mark International Trans Visibility Day;
entries.22b0d2b6080f34883861a77367e30b66bd85c890: Whereas the City of Montreal was, in the summer of 2025, the host city of the first international LGBTQ2+ Francophone conference organized by Égides, Alliance internationale francophone pour l'égalité et les diversités, the largest international LGBTQI+ Francophone organization, founded in Montreal in 2019;
entries.0b3771b3764f7ecbb61dbf93f85174be563db290: Whereas Montreal magazine Fugues, the only Quebec and French-Canadian media to follow LGBTQ+ news, has released its 500th issue this month;
entries.c0a49402eaac5a5cc8bc4aadb9213652dd552055: Whereas Fugues has been informing, bringing together and changing attitudes since 1984 and the publication has made a significant contribution to the development of the Village, making this neighbourhood an area of openness and inclusiveness while pushing Montreal to the top of inclusive destinations around the world;
entries.8051c3a7f42dd0e57f2e35b5e791f76fcc6845e5: Whereas all Montrealers are free to develop fully, regardless of their gender identity and sexual orientation, in accordance with their fundamental rights proclaimed and guaranteed by the Charter of Human Rights and Freedoms of Quebec and the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms;
entries.eebe6f693018b75ae4ad4a9425aa3d10a6e3f1fd: Whereas the City of Montreal has put in place awareness-raising tools and training dedicated to its municipal staff and members of the police force to better meet the needs of LGBTQ2+ communities in the city's services and boroughs through the application of the ads+.
entries.187f4032b8571f47ca49af36089c02390dc35fe5: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Benoit Langevin for the presentation of the Declaration.
entries.b1a142b9ffffffb1d559c76b727798c4ab650cd2: At the outset, Councillor Benoit Langevin highlighted the International Day against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia on 17 May, while recalling that it was a Montreal-born initiative that had since been taken up in many countries. He then stressed that diversity was a fundamental asset in the metropolis, and that the achievements of inclusion must be constantly protected and defended, particularly in a context where there are setbacks elsewhere in the world.
entries.a39014d85f44d68ed6d4d212803bd0d03104311c: In this regard, Mr. Langevin highlights the City of Montreal's sustained commitment to combating all forms of discrimination, citing in particular the adoption of declarations, the adoption of policies that promote fairness and representativeness, or the close collaboration with organizations and experts from the LGBTQ2IA+ community. Finally, he reiterates the importance of solidarity and the role of allied individuals in relation to the annual theme of the Emergence Foundation, while thanking community organizations for their essential contribution.
entries.793244b3b63e43a2d8a729965ec5013c938264a5: The Chair gave the floor to Councillor Claude Pinard and the Deputy Leader of the Official Opposition, Christopher McCray, respectively.
entries.323de2c6ca90ebc5d8eb89138eb11381287d7ab3: Pinard first addressed Montreal's historic commitment to the fight against homophobia, transphobia and biphobia, recalling that the metropolis had distinguished itself as a pioneer in inclusiveness towards people in the LGBTQ+ community. He then highlighted the Village's central role as a safe and emblematic space for people in the community to come together, fully exist and gain visibility, thus contributing to Montréal's international reach.
entries.eaaca39a910cbb5b603ebec88873976cb103aca0: In addition, Councillor Claude Pinard recognizes the joint contribution of the Village and the magazine Fugues, whose publication of the 500th issue reflects his sustained role for several decades in informing and changing mentalities and asserting Montreal as an internationally recognized inclusive destination. He thanks the teams who have worked on these advances.
entries.9d695dcf9a2c57ef474f92e8e5200ef8705d92f4: As for the Deputy Leader of the Official Opposition, Christopher McCray, he highlighted this International Day against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia by recalling that Montréal is a recognized environment for its openness and diversity, which promotes the inclusion of people from LGBTQ+ communities. He followed by noting the progress made over the years in terms of rights and social acceptance, while recognizing that these advances remain uneven and are based in particular on the action of community organizations.
entries.9cbc71a1bb53b6409e51ce735af8d19e0db1337b: In conclusion, Mr McCray stressed the importance of the role of allied parties and the need to take concrete action, including addressing discriminatory statements and raising awareness of the values of diversity, inclusion and respect.
entries.0c0e7fc4671aa8a95453734a7f3a5bf1d6ea749a: The Chair of the Board, Chantal Rossi, thanked Council members for their interventions.

entries.0484847e9045b7a45ef658a2ba1f7d311e77171f: 2 - celebrate the recipients at an event in City Hall to express their gratitude and gratitude to its exceptional restaurateurs;
entries.597c24a87a967cebf57bebd242f27e0ee871d0a3: 3 - invites citizens as well as people passing through the metropolis to discover new tables, enjoy terraces and, more broadly, support local gastronomy.
entries.f22a8e46d5abf7cd5cca3b936acfc8653eb7e81e: Whereas May is a highlight of Montreal gastronomy, as well as elsewhere in Quebec and across Canada, with the unveiling of Michelin Guide distinctions, the Gala des Lauriers de la gastronomye and the publication of Canada's 100 Best Restaurants;
entries.c7736003a926a63fc9befd4f6b6e8c5a4a9f7bf0: Whereas Montreal is distinguished by the excellence of its gastronomy, both accessible, rooted in the terroir and open to the world;
entries.6bcb31ac72646190c8e80b7f289824b2460ffbd6: Whereas, in addition to being a grouping, gastronomy is an economic and cultural lever for the metropolis, creating jobs and vitality in all neighbourhoods;
entries.116fab3786da39c25626bab0afd64cd60f4ca25a: Whereas gastronomy has a direct impact on the attractiveness and outreach of the metropolis, attracting visitors from all over the world;
entries.ed7f5a1792691ca15cd930cd01679962a7812d29: Whereas the Michelin Guide recognizes a dynamic culinary ecosystem, driven by the innovation, diversity and quality of local products as well as the know-how of restaurateurs throughout the world;
entries.609a2ab83d5feb11d1f37fe8a7ba64b7e72873d5: Whereas on May 6, the Michelin Guide unveiled its 2026 edition in Quebec and awarded stars to restaurants that have distinguished themselves exceptionally, as well as Bib Gourmand and recommendations;
entries.32a934c057b44ba6f19037537c3301c8ba14f5f1: Whereas two new restaurants in the metropolis had the honour of receiving a Michelin star in 2026, namely Hoogan and Beaufort and Sushi Nishinokaze, and that Jérôme Ferrer-Europea, Mastard and Sabayon kept their stars for a second year;
entries.d3e808fe12fe3cea77eb37002cdccdbdb294e68f: Whereas the Michelin Guide has awarded a gourmet Bib to seven Montreal establishments, and 49 restaurants in the metropolis will now be recommended in the famous guide;
entries.ebedd9490b5e8b60ecb0810cf5a7434f491a5f0b: Whereas with more than 60 distinguished restaurants, including five Michelin-starred restaurants, Montreal is a great gastronomic metropolis and confirms its place on the world map of major culinary destinations around the world;
entries.aa5b82984d487dcf3f25ce33e308b636da6370a7: Whereas the Lauriers de la Gastronomie is a non-profit organization whose mission is to stimulate and promote excellence, creativity and succession in gastronomy in Quebec;
entries.ec9ec2cd4ecbf8363c7bcc1318198b051faa006b: Whereas at the Lauriers de la Gastronomy gala held on May 4th, Montreal restaurants Le Toqué!, Le Sabayon, Le Mousso, as well as Hoogan and Beaufort and the Annette bar-à-vin in the Sommelier of the year category were rewarded;
entries.8ad9fc3e45e8484c56f9c4c8376a06279551d2d4: Whereas Canada's Best 100 Restaurants, a magazine that provides an annual portrait of the country's restaurant industry, has for 12 years highlighted the quality of its table;
entries.842babafe177862b839fef4217243ceb28d42396: Whereas Montreal restaurants occupy more than a quarter of Canada's Best 100 Restaurants list 2026, with 28 addresses on the list, three of which are among the top ten establishments, Mon Rabbit, Beba and Le Violin;
entries.f1bd74ab8546dd2f5b808a5a4ee5907a6a9e6c4b: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Maude Théroux-Séguin for the presentation of the Declaration.
entries.cfbcf16088b619022bba7910c036c80dea14fde7: Counselor Maude Théroux-Séguin noted first that the first week of May was a significant moment for Montreal gastronomy, notably because of the holding of several major events and awards, including the Gala des Lauriers, the Canada-100 Best ranking and the publication of the Michelin guide. She then indicated that these recognitions confirmed Montréal's position as a leading gastronomic destination, both nationally and internationally, and highlighted the strong presence of Montreal establishments among the distinguished restaurants.
entries.1a937c03f463ace2e235c6c9bbf96e4dbcae44ad: She also pointed out that the quality, creativity and diversity of the culinary offer contribute to the cultural identity of the metropolis, while contributing to its economic dynamism. In addition, Ms. Théroux-Séguin highlighted the fact that gastronomy is spread throughout all boroughs and plays a structuring role in the vitality of neighbourhoods, notably by supporting commercial activity and the food ecosystem, including suppliers and urban agriculture.
entries.40508b7d371c9407c087aaa94b78837b1790ff3c: Finally, Councillor Maude Théroux-Séguin congratulated the institutions that had received awards and thanked all stakeholders in the community for their contributions, and then invited board members to adopt the Declaration.
entries.da7979c49c8de86c350dde7f8cdf628f81b7139e: The Chair of the Board gave the floor to the Leader of the Official Opposition, Ericka Alneus, and Councillor Émilie Brière, respectively.
entries.c6dc7add3afb1b4b3a737d6c82488cfa740fef34: From the outset, Ms. Alneus greets all the actors in the catering industry, highlighting their contribution and expertise, which she illustrates with personal experience. She also points out that Montreal offers high-quality gastronomy throughout its territory, both in the city centre and in its eccentric boroughs, and invites the public to discover local restaurants, noting that this allows both to support the economy and to strengthen collective pride for the metropolis.
entries.26441ba2afafdc94ac0677738a5c38e04ced008c: For her part, Ms. Brière shares, among other things, her personal conception of Montreal gastronomy, which she describes as a gathering experience based on the sharing of techniques, flavours and cultures. In conclusion, she demonstrates her pride in celebrating Montreal gastronomy and warmly thanks the local actors for their contribution.
entries.29949d6c62ba6b4e7ffb345fbb38529890429df1: 1 - marks May as Jewish Heritage Month in Montreal, Canada and several countries around the world;
entries.37e33002fa58e6cd4e32aae2f9dc76ceda8594a0: 2 - recognize the richness and plurality of the Jewish heritage and that it is woven in all spheres of Montreal activity;
entries.306aacfc5bfbeaf2755587ed6756bb0790d63fb8: 3 - reaffirms its commitment to combat anti-Semitism and strongly denounces any anti-Semitic gesture and attack while reiterating that not all incidents and hate crimes have their place in the metropolis;
entries.02710d627b1c3d6f0944de59d2c78e2165ec72d3: 4 - encourages openness to the other, benevolence and solidarity, while promoting a living together based on this exceptional strength of the metropolis, which is the richness of its diversity.
entries.1a9b4a36b85e99922aab310d9e3e7af36ebfdfeb: Whereas Jewish Heritage Month is celebrated all over the world in May, and Canada has officially recognized it since 2018;
entries.d72edfb9197160e579ae5297096fd3b864d9f51e: Whereas Jewish Heritage Month is an opportunity for all Montrealers of Jewish and non-Jewish descent to celebrate the cultural and plural heritage of this community deeply rooted in the history of the metropolis;
entries.48b4eaa68427ff0ebfe081faede3d44ec1748119: Whereas Jewish families from Africa, Europe, Asia and Latin America have been established in Montreal for more than a century and perpetuate the Ashkenazi, Sefarad, Mizrahie, Francophone and Anglophone traditions on the territory;
entries.1bf8d0321f574b57c5dea9763db5dbf1a4396843: Whereas more than 100,000 people identify with the Jewish community in Montreal and the metropolis is the third largest city in the world with the most survivors and survivors of the Holocaust;
entries.560931c3944d3059073e21272ad21b31852db846: Whereas the Montreal Jewish community is plural, and this diversity is expressed in particular by origin, language, culture, music, cooking, how to practise a religion, ideas, debates, ways of approaching collective life and civic commitment;
entries.5e6db5220f32cfe08dc625d1ccd00318511a395c: Whereas Jewish Heritage Month is an opportunity for Jewish people to share their traditions and better understand the multiple stories that exist in the community, as well as allowing all Montrealers to learn more about the richness of this culture;
entries.fc6b396c660f09df17b578450f597fabe15d7101: Whereas the Jewish community can count on many organizations and institutions in the metropolis to preserve this memory, tell stories and demonstrate the immense contributions of this community to the cultural, economic and social development of Montreal;
entries.da9c844a5574ef363282e7922a4271b9bab73cf4: Whereas the Jewish heritage is deeply rooted in the districts, schools, shops and cultural institutions of the metropolis;
entries.017770d9b4ddd947f38d894944b02202175c8bf8: Whereas in recent years there has been a resurgence of anti-Semitic attacks and incidents in Montreal, Canada and around the world;
entries.fc7eeed66fbb625e630fd2372ee1beacc8823cb6: Whereas Montreal is a city recognized for its values of openness, justice and fairness, and actively struggles for freedom and tolerance;
entries.7113c2aa5cd612bb821f23a1fb1b9ea63f1e20dc: Whereas the City of Montreal is committed to combating racism and discrimination, as well as promoting harmonious intercultural relations with respect and understanding by adopting the Montreal Declaration against Racial Discrimination, the Montreal Declaration for Cultural Diversity and Inclusion, the Declaration to Recognize the Systemic Character of Racism and Discrimination and the Montreal Charter of Rights and Responsibilities;
entries.35b363ed5882b75d987d2c11b369ba85262e8ad6: Whereas, following the Round Table on Combating Anti-Semitism in Montreal in 2015, the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal established, in 2016, a Unit for Incidents and Hate Crimes to investigate more effectively reports and complaints of incidents and hate crimes;
entries.316fff850479df3a3b0b8757634936e2a9e9306d: The Chair of the Board, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to the author of the Statement to Councillor Sonny Moroz for his presentation.
entries.22d828cbd563766d6cea7be436fec586a2162355: First, Councillor Sonny Moroz stressed the importance of taking a moment to highlight the unique character of the Jewish community among the Montreal population, as Jewish reality has changed since October 7, 2023, here and around the world.
entries.e8b2f73d3d021c661b0ede0bf68ac0bfb56e4e70: Also, by attending the last summit on anti-Semitism in Toronto, he noted that all major municipalities were experiencing an increase in hate crimes and a loss of dialogue with the population. Moroz mentioned that in Toronto children were educated about Jewish historical heritage from year four rather than at the first secondary level, as in Quebec. He added that the City of Montreal had received several Holocaust survivors. Finally, he invited the entire Montreal community to visit the Holocaust Museum before moving to St. Lawrence Boulevard and also invited us to create positive and joyful events, because the Jewish community was not only defined by the Holocaust.
entries.d7fd2cef5d8ffec633a7128681bb93234656bbc9: The chair of the council gave the floor to Councillor Leslie Roberts, official Opposition leader Marie Plourde, and official Opposition leader Ericka Alneus, respectively.
entries.337b38fd80d3b95ef275c2894bc91ff9d6a004c4: Councillor Leslie Roberts noted that members of the Jewish community continued to suffer discrimination and deplored the persistence of anti-Semitism. He recalled the need to banish all forms of hatred and called for a collective mobilization to put an end to it. In this regard, he stressed the right of every citizen to feel safe in Montreal and thanked community leaders for their commitment.
entries.898787e142f9a1f4f6f7e58bc9ab6650917d29f6: In the same spirit, official Opposition leader Marie Plourde highlights the contribution of Jewish communities to Montréal's cultural wealth. She also evokes prominent figures such as Leonard Cohen and Malka Zipora (Malka Zipper), while putting Jewish heritage on the forefront. In this regard, she refers to the Montreal Holocaust Museum, which she describes as an essential place of memory, awareness and dialogue.
entries.8a32b1dd319ffd495a897aebe4201af7f3f1c654: In closing, the leader of the Official Opposition Ericka Alneus joins her colleagues in welcoming people to the balcony. She believes in the role of culture as a lever for rapprochement, notably by mentioning Leonard Cohen's mural and the work of photographer Gabor Szilasi. She recalls that valuing the contributions of Jewish communities is a concrete means of combating anti-Semitism.
entries.0af7812793b46e3c5c85787ef1a7dfc02a184643: 1 - recognize 25 May as World Day for Africa;
entries.d4aff6a0cea2d74e7383cc8c08074b7620dbcaf9: 2 - highlights the immense contributions of communities of African descent to the history and economic, social and cultural development as well as to Montréal's influence in the Francophonie and around the world;
entries.686541ba33c533f8d9f6e3b634207ea4501d49df: 3 - encourages all citizens to celebrate World Day in Africa on 25 May 2026, and to take advantage of the opportunity to discover the cultural, historical, heritage, economic and human richness of Africa.
entries.30a3c01b0e73829cb8f782fff753d859787fa0da: Whereas all over the world, World Day of Africa is celebrated on 25 May in order to commemorate the establishment of the Organization of the African Union on that same date in 1963, which became the African Union in 2002;
entries.8c972827b238ef09f3cb37b0d9b1dc1d06a2ed92: Whereas the World Day of Africa, first known as the African Day of Freedom, was established almost 70 years ago to underscore the deep will and determination of the African people to free themselves from the domination and exploitation of foreign countries;
entries.4a675117f881b6ee3164a32194cee3a34f496d7c: Whereas there are 1.3 million people of African origin in Canada, more than 65% of whom are first-generation immigrants, and the majority of them are settled in Montreal, according to a census of 2021; Whereas, as a French-speaking metropolis in the Americas firmly committed to the valorization and promotion of French, the City of Montréal recognizes the immense contribution of the African people to the spread of this common language with over 167 million people who use it, which is equivalent to more than 54.7% of users worldwide;
entries.6b58873ecfc1f1f97faaf56c03098a5849633749: Whereas Montreal is a privileged host city for the African diaspora, and that it actively contributes to the economic, scientific, social, academic and cultural development of the metropolis while shaping its exceptional multicultural character;
entries.70dd3e59bd09da4e13ac2b47346bcea67b7724cc: Whereas the implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (ACFTAAf) and the increasing economic dynamism of the African continent more generally open up opportunities for increased collaboration between the African territory and Montreal;
entries.01e18377decbbb420c5e048180a1b3d29e6fce1f: Whereas strengthening economic and commercial partnerships between Montreal and African nations is an important lever for development, innovation and job creation, both for the city and its partners on the African continent;
entries.1ab50123aafd447b5d32c1674dcb087080574ce6: Whereas more and more people of African descent are taking up leadership positions in the public service, as well as on the municipal council, executive committee and standing committees, and that the City of Montreal has put in place policies to ensure a fair representation of persons of diversity in the municipal administration;
entries.05f344e02f4d7f9151b85bd64294f0463c20b0eb: Whereas the members of the African diaspora, in the richness and plurality of its cultural and linguistic expressions, are bridge builders between Montreal and the African continent, devoting themselves to the influence of intercultural dialogue, arts, culture, economic exchanges, diplomacy, social justice, and much more;
entries.68161eea5aee0cb684773aaa9fae34df7b591772: The Chair, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to Councillor Josué Corvil for the presentation of the Declaration and then to Councillor Martine Musau Muele.
entries.823e6fe9faadc4c0a10711d77e0c1e87ee0a9941: From the outset, Councillor Josué Corvil took the floor to highlight the significance of the 25 May recognition as World Day for Africa in Montreal, a gesture that made a lasting contribution to the collective heritage of the metropolis. In particular, he recalled that Africa is a vast, rich and diverse continent, composed of 54 countries and thousands of languages, where many cultures and peoples with multiple identities coexist. He stressed that Africa was the cradle of humanity, marked by ancient history and major contributions in architecture, medicine and thought. He also evoked the great historical and political figures of Africa.
entries.9f00826ff421889a0338824b4ea34fd0e6c40258: In addition, Mr. Corvil believes that World Africa Day symbolizes the struggles for freedom, development and valorization of African cultural riches that have shaped African diasporas around the world. He highlights the essential contribution of African communities in Montreal, whose presence and vitality contribute to shaping the metropolis. He believes it is necessary to continue efforts to build bridges, strengthen dialogue and meet the challenges of inclusion and equality. Councillor Josué Corvil concludes by stating that recognizing this day means a vision of a city that advances, unites and makes its diversity a real force.
entries.c4331b1305af91fc52d094508f099ff5ae2ebdc6: Speaking then, Councillor Martine Musau Muele began by welcoming the people present on the balcony and thanked Councillor Josué Corvil for his invitation to participate in this statement and shared her reflection on the relevance of this day devoted to Africa. She stressed that this day was above all a call for the freedom, solidarity and emancipation of African peoples. Ms. Musua Muele highlighted the contribution of the African community to the social, cultural and economic vitality of the metropolis. She concluded by calling for strengthening ties with Africa, supporting concrete actions and helping to build a more just, inclusive and supportive society.
entries.c55aed3bd0e17f1bdc1742309833be378c0a7eb0: The Chair of the Board, Chantal Rossi, thanked both members of the Board for their interventions.
entries.25406c814c2fb4789857f0a7e076b3e344d0e04e: 1 - that the City of Montreal express its deep gratitude to Dr. Marie-Hélène Marchand and to Ms. Laurence de Villers for their compassion and generosity with respect to Mr. Collin, as well as for their daily work;
entries.8e28a3cd0572449ccbd326984cf3b4bbf7b281a4: 2 - the City of Montreal stresses the importance of community health organizations in the metropolitan area, which each day assist more vulnerable people, especially those who are at the end of their lives in conditions of great insecurity;
entries.8aea64ccda7a1ae0aad26243f407e0c04d4b0410: 3 - that the City of Montreal thank La Presse and journalist Caroline Touzin for having told Mr. Collin's touching story, and that she hopes that this account will help raise awareness among readers about this sadly too widespread reality;
entries.405e8f59ff53cb1c7376652e8ba74da185a9657d: 4 - that the City of Montreal invite all Montrealers to show generosity through concrete gestures of mutual assistance and solidarity;
entries.1ea8eb8b55e497c4b6920e25d25a647f1082a0e5: 5 - that every person has the right to die with respect and dignity.
entries.2f58ac35fc2a67b5715b60c47c3d1cc6b63c7682: Whereas La Presse recently told the story of Luc Collin, a great hockey amateur living in homelessness who has terminal lung cancer;
entries.6dc4841e75704ccdab6f836d53dbcdb7952ca2f9: Whereas Dr. Marie-Hélène Marchand, co-founder of Maison Mobile, and Ms. Laurence de Villers, director of the Society for Palliative Home Care in Greater Montreal, allowed Mr. Collin to realize a dream by finding him a pair of tickets to attend a Canadian hockey game in Montreal at the Bell Centre on April 11;
entries.d751ea1ce6c837f5b188849d52a8930df5765b9d: Whereas every year dozens of homeless people die from chronic diseases in shelters or on the street without proper medical follow-up, and these are all unacceptable and preventable human tragedies;
entries.b41a6f71f785f3311b0b3c04bdcdc3bf58457099: Whereas Maison Mobile, an initiative created in 2024, provides palliative care to people who are more vulnerable at the end of their lives directly in their environment, whether on the street, in a shelter or in a room house;
entries.2c1e17d4f469a59de7562de0b0a6738768ca07e6: Whereas the most recent data reveal that more than 5000 people live in homelessness in Montreal, an under-estimated figure which represents only the tip of the iceberg according to the Montreal Single and Traveller Assistance Network;
entries.8988ba52715406a430fd3f78b664a5e5817406e4: Whereas far too many people live in a situation of great human distress and insecurity, with very difficult living conditions in Montreal;
entries.d6c0594c09d5070e41a381444d6e4f5e991e7597: Whereas there is a need to strengthen interventions at all levels of government in a concerted manner, in collaboration with the health and social services network, to better support community-based organizations so that they can adequately address the needs of vulnerable people in the metropolitan area;
entries.0a4ec68ad6b88116c2db98e661f72a4f3c65082f: At the outset, Ms. Martinez Ferrada recalls a landmark article in La Presse telling the story of Luc Collin, a homeless person with terminally ill cancer. She points out that this reality, although often invisible, is present in Montreal, where sick people often die without adequate support. She states that no one should live the end of their life under such conditions.
entries.7d026a878a20e215df438cff80d06b110951711f: The Mayor of Montreal then highlighted the commitment of Dr. Marie-Hélène Marchand who founded Maison mobile and Laurence de Villiers, director of the Society for Palliative Home Care in Greater Montreal. Both women offered palliative care to the most vulnerable people. She expressed, on behalf of the City of Montréal, deep gratitude to these women and their teams. Finally, Ms. Martinez Ferrada stressed the importance of ensuring a dignified and respectful end of life for all.
entries.ca3379777588d402839fbac6ceab0f83cc866624: The Chair thanked the Mayor of Montreal for her intervention.

entries.b186f6519ff443482891dc86f3af923522ca67b1: 1 - that the City Council take note of the new provincial measure allowing for the reimbursement of property transfer fees for first-time buyers;
entries.eba5c1358262ae815a1280572ca1185572cc17ff: 2 - that the City Council acknowledge that this measure provides the City of Montreal with an opportunity to review the relevance, scope and objectives of the Residential Acquisition Support Program;
entries.bae8f4969b069d45d2c0dc6721472b5a18b9df9a: 3 - that the municipal council request the municipal government to undertake a review of the Residential Acquisition Support Program to assess the possibility of reallocating some of the financial resources made available by the provincial measure;
entries.f666158e8aa833393dd0ab088b769187959ae4c6: 4 - whether the purpose of this review is to establish a municipal rent fund or to enter into an agreement with a Montreal community organization, such as the Maison du père, to support or enhance an existing rent aid bank;
entries.ea949f15a5c29ba260f32dd09a2feb986f9f83c2: 5 - that any assistance granted under such a fund or agreement be directed to tenant households residing in the territory of the City of Montreal, at low income and risk of losing their housing;
entries.92233c7c862576f06b362fadc9510b7a581bd06e: 6 - that the municipal administration evaluate the modalities for ensuring rigorous monitoring of the sums invested and maximising the impacts on preventing housing loss and homelessness.
entries.803d84bc59716819fc7fe0cc08c07c7a436d41e3: Whereas the Government of Quebec has announced a new measure allowing first purchasers of a principal residence to obtain a substantial refund of property transfer duties ("welcome tax"), up to $5,875, through a refundable tax credit;
entries.3133f9e2373248586e84be4ba9de54a6bb92614d: Whereas this measure provides for the repayment of 100% of the first $5,000 paid in transfer rights and 25% of the additional amounts, which constitutes significant financial support for homeowners;
entries.aa83e829d45e72b1146964af7640f48d261f880d: Whereas this provincial measure provides direct financial relief to first-time buyers without reducing municipal property transfer tax revenues;
entries.761f218dd0ffe43be8fecf61c84c633dfd045c85: Whereas the City of Montreal introduced, in 2018, the Residential Acquisition Support Program to facilitate access to property for Montreal households, including first-time buyers and families, with a view to promoting the maintenance of homes on Montréal territory and supporting the vitality of neighbourhoods;
entries.506efd77751ca02cdea3237485cb15dbfed7d211: Whereas this new reality alters the context within which the Residential Acquisition Support Program of the City of Montreal is being implemented and warrants reflection on the relevance and achievement of its current objectives;
entries.56b05da1bff85b348a6f55a03723c976b1a2a8d6: Whereas the housing crisis in Montreal particularly affects low-income tenant households, many of which are experiencing temporary financial difficulties that may result in late payment of rent and increased risk of loss of housing;
entries.64cf78e1f25ad8946dea91b080b33ad2735a18bd: Whereas the prevention of housing loss is an effective means of reducing homelessness, reducing pressure on emergency accommodation services and promoting residential stability;
entries.db7af5191dd732b019eb76f48071a5c7ef0c853e: Whereas the Maison du père is a Montreal community organization that has been working for several decades to prevent homelessness and support people and households in vulnerable situations;
entries.5c9bdded7699c95d402f7a00e1f210a619d31218: Whereas the Father's House has set up a rent support bank, i.e. a one-time financial support service for households facing temporary difficulties in paying their rent, with the aim of avoiding loss of housing;
entries.2e4ccceb71f741ee2e9788ac90c85f98da2d9b5c: Whereas this rent aid bank is part of an integrated approach combining targeted financial assistance with support to promote the financial autonomy of assisted persons and the efficient use of available funds;
entries.8933b4098380c8e64f4597e038df2a4a7c9c5f5f: Whereas the rapid and targeted assistance for rent helps to prevent more severe precarisation trajectories for the households concerned and more costly for the community;
entries.c06b854ba8007bfebcad90899aef3601ded8089e: Whereas the City of Montreal has a responsibility to support prevention tools in housing and can, for this purpose, establish municipal mechanisms or enter into agreements with community organizations with recognized expertise in Montréal;
entries.435e04e2ffa7f131003b0dee9aa83bd16b6a97cf: The Chair of Council, Chantal Rossi, gave the floor to the proposer of the motion, Councillor Martine Musau Muele, and subsequently to the Authority's representative for this matter, Councillor Caroline Braun.
entries.40ad3b402b0c99ee08cb83cd716b977dd6d82879: In summary, Ms. Musau Muelle, in connection with the provincial government's announcement of a new refundable tax credit to help early homeowners, expressed the importance of revising the current Municipal Home Acquisition Support Program (MRSP) to, among other things, equip and act in the fight against poverty and homelessness.
entries.db5635a5d717a073b26fd9fd178d14b3b0fdd20b: As for Mrs Braun, she also felt that the humanitarian crisis of homelessness and housing must be tackled together and noted that there was a consensus in this regard.
entries.3756a1c5ed84300afb5dafd31993eacebf0f0cfb: add the following text after the third Expected:
entries.cab3889948c40d1cf3b85c7641f7f3ad794804cd: " WHEREAS access to property has deteriorated in recent years, with more savings and income needed, and the growing competition with experienced buyers and investors is pushing back first-time buyers and families."
entries.6ac57750533946177984b8df096a551f369b757a: add the following text after the fourth Expected:
entries.b663e3cfb060272964226c454f6590914a1fec8a: " WHEREAS the Commission on Economic, Urban and Housing Development (CDEUH) filed its report on the Residential Acquisition Support Program (DRAP) in January 2025, which led the Housing Service to undertake an analysis process that included Montréal's attractiveness, market conditions, RSAP performance and partner consultation."
entries.626b711a5e92c0ce08d9f31a7614f63f5bc1175e: to replace the third, fourth and fifth Solved with the following text:
entries.73138d48d5afb5cd0b5fcb6db80af01d0e9e5cb9: "That the Home Acquisition Support Program be reviewed to support first-time buyers of new properties, including through the introduction of financial instruments to facilitate initial capitalization;
entries.dac7a9782782c0f28dc9b2c7d075e86f251df902: THAT the City increase funding to Montreal community organizations that support vulnerable people on the ground in prevention and housing search, including the Father's House and the Bon accueil Mission, in order to support a housing bank and rent aid;
entries.d4781e6bd05ca22ca5bd14043c6f59614822ce58: THAT the City continue discussions with the Working Group on Homelessness Prevention and Control, which includes organizations such as FRAPRU, OMHM, FOHM, RAPSIM, SSIH, DRSP, UQAM and CIUSSS;"

entries.57152fac93be9d23494dfc4c93f9799c1deb3d2b: 1- that the municipal council take note of the concerns expressed publicly by the Chief Electoral Officer of Quebec regarding the lack of legislative framework for the use of artificial intelligence by political parties;
entries.4169e196db578ae915ee1334ebf2a04e1dae3ec8: 2- take note of the urgent appeals by Quebec experts to guide the use of artificial intelligence in politics, particularly with a view to future municipal election campaigns;
entries.459f3a59ba3291f21f7c5efb9c56aa027704dd11: 3- that a non-partisan code of conduct has been drawn up for this purpose by Quebec researchers, based in particular on principles of transparency, responsible use, data protection and prevention of misinformation;
entries.317e49c37c3c6387ae90c4b4b926c72d19db72a6: 4- it recognises that the lack of common rules on the use of artificial intelligence by municipal political parties cracks and undermines public confidence in the validity of information available online and, consequently, towards local democratic institutions;
entries.a9e8ebce95395c78bfa4d37547405ffab2bd38be: 5- therefore, the municipal council asks all municipal political parties and independent teams to commit themselves to adhere without delay to the Code of Conduct of the Consortium for Research, Training and Knowledge Mobilization in Artificial Intelligence (IVADO);
entries.ab4b3bbc8ddc20151ba2b4f4cc82dd9ce6230a8c: 6- that the city council ask all political parties, independent teams, independent politicians and candidates from all levels of government in Canada to adhere without delay to the Code of Conduct for the Use of AI and thus reaffirm their commitment to a strong democratic health and shared reality.
entries.0107cd03f2caaa42065cb7aea8739b776d0cbb7f: Whereas the integrity of public debate is an essential foundation of municipal democracy, and that citizens' confidence is based on access to reliable, transparent and unmanipulated political information;
entries.345f48ddda953d5285044f41638b819af21b85ce: Whereas the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in political communications, including automated generation of texts, images, videos and audio content, can contribute to misinformation, manipulation of public opinion and creation of misleading content;
entries.04f4a84391efdea57fa25036580cee4f4abd5b5b: Whereas the Chief Electoral Officer of Québec (DGEQ) has publicly expressed his concerns about the lack of legislative framework regarding the use of AI by political parties;
entries.4873ac933db768388fb16435306399169aa53c28: Whereas several Quebec experts call for clear and rapid leadership in the use of AI in politics, particularly with a view to future electoral campaigns;
entries.6befaf399001af9de2613425c6d5bf6a01f956fa: Whereas Quebec researchers have developed a non-partisan code of conduct to guide the use of AI in politics, based in particular on principles of transparency, responsible use, data protection and prevention of misinformation;
entries.717bd2916735b5da3e453610b6ed1078b5951c92: Whereas on March 24, 2026, the National Assembly of Quebec unanimously adopted a motion recognizing the need to frame the use of artificial intelligence in politics and calling on political parties to adhere to the Code of Good Conduct drawn up by IVADO;
entries.43be2477c00c3ffd5a678a3c03107815292645fe: Whereas the absence of common rules on the use of AI by municipal political parties may undermine public confidence in the validity of information available online and, consequently, towards democratic institutions;
entries.d386c944263b71176ea252802894c636cdc3e5a1: Whereas the City of Montreal has a responsibility to promote a sound, equitable and resilient political environment in response to emerging risks associated with digital technologies;
entries.4c749d8141bf18bea6c2bb880333d1ceb54ec99a: Whereas, as a world leader in AI and proud host city of the responsible Montreal IA Declaration, the City of Montréal bears the duty to take stock of the social changes that are taking place and anticipate the serious risks posed by the development of AI;
entries.9ac1cdca87bf5f468f4b4d0e9c995ac39dfce192: In his presentation, Mr. Demers-Dubé demonstrates in particular the strength and dangers of AI in electoral campaigns, by putting online hyperstructures, ensuring that true and false are matched equally in our reality. Consequently, collective confidence in the democratic process is shaken. In conclusion, he cites several examples supporting his point of view and brings several means and solutions to deal with this phenomenon.
entries.dd36c35943bcd6eabfbf26823480869ef7711a39: to continue work until the agenda is exhausted.
entries.5dc2666bba0a28c548b8dd59601c6b034e219df4: The proposal was approved and the Chair of the Board then invited the Authority's representative, Councillor Alexandre Teodoresco, to speak on this matter.
entries.d4ae18c98ab417018216e7d3cbeab9f6203a578c: Mr Teodoresco began by saying that he supported the fundamental objective of this motion, which was to protect the integrity of municipal public debate in the age of artificial intelligence; moreover, he had no doubt about the findings made earlier; however, he felt that it was necessary to take the time to do things right; for that purpose, he believed that the Administration had the time to put forward a process of consultation and in-depth consultation before the next municipal elections in order to deal more broadly with this technological challenge.
